spandarūpā saṅkṣubdhatā | naśyati | tathety arthaḥ | ataḥ dṛśyābhāvakṛtasyādraṣṭṛtvasya kevalībhāvatvaṃ yuktam eveti bhāvaḥ ||
etad eva atidurbodhatvāt punaḥ punaḥ kathayati
trijagat tvam ahaṃ ceti dṛśye 'sattām upāgate /
niṣkrāntaḥ bhittau apatitaḥ prakāśaḥ netragamyaḥ bhavati |
trijagat tvaṃ ahaṃ ceti dṛśye asattām
ahaṃ tvaṃ jagad ityādau praśānte dṛśyasambhrame /
syāt tādṛśī kevalatā sthite draṣṭary avīkṣake //
| yathā pratibimbābhāve śuddhaṃ darpaṇamātram eva tiṣṭhati tathā dṛśyābhāve śuddhaḥ draṣṭā eva tiṣṭhatīti bhāvaḥ ||
sac cen na śāmyatīdaṃ vā nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ /
asattāṃ ca na vidmo 'smin dṛśye doṣapradāyini //
| svarūpahāniprasaṅgāt | anyathā vahner api dāhakatvahāniḥ syāt | nanu tarhi asad eva
tasmāt katham iyaṃ śāmyed brahman dṛśyaviṣūcikā /
asya dṛśyapiśācasya śāntyai mantram imaṃ śṛṇu /
rāmātyantam ayaṃ yena mṛtim eṣyati naṅkṣyati //
adarśanaṃ yāti | yuktaṃ ca piśācasya mantreṇa maraṇam adarśanaṃ ca ||
yad asti tasya nāśo 'sti na kadācana rāghava /
yasmāt tan naṣṭam apy antar bījabhūtaṃ bhaved dhṛdi //
naṣṭam api vastu hṛdi punaḥ punaḥ āvartamānam ||
nanu tataḥ ko doṣaḥ ity | atrāha
itthaṃ nirmokṣadoṣaḥ syān na ca tasyāṃśasambhavaḥ /
| sthūlasūkṣmabhāvena dvividhasya dṛśyābhāvasyaiva mokṣatvāt | nanu bhavatu saḥ doṣaḥ | kim asmākaṃ kariṣyatīty | atrāha
yadi syāj jagadādīdaṃ tat syān mokṣo na kasyacit /
bāhyastham astu hṛtsthaṃ vā dṛśyaṃ nāśāya kevalam //
| yathā tathā sambhāvite 'pi dṛśyanāśe smṛtiprabhāvāt sūkṣmatayā punaḥ dṛśyasphuraṇāt | yataḥ
nanu tarhi kiṃ kāryam ity | atrāha
tasmād imāṃ pratijñāṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu rāmātibhīṣaṇām /
yām uttareṇa granthena nūnaṃ tvam avabudhyase //
jagacchabdasya rāmārtho nanu nāsty eva kaścana //
sattāṃ na bhajati eva | na tu sattābhāg bhūtvā naśyati | tathā ca sati na nirmokṣadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ | na hi asataḥ bandhakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam iti bhāvaḥ |
nanu puraḥsphurataḥ ahamādikasya jagataḥ kathaṃ sarvathā sattvaṃ yuktam ity | atrāha
yad idaṃ dṛśyate kiñcid dṛśyajālaṃ purogatam /
evaṃ brahmaiva tat sarvam ajarāmaram avyayam //
bhavanam | tathā ca sati bhāsamānasyāpi jagataḥ asattvaṃ yuktam eva | na hi jale bhāsamānasyāpi taraṅgasya sattvaṃ dṛṣṭam iti bhāvaḥ ||
vyomany evoditaṃ vyoma brahma brahmaṇi tiṣṭhati //

bṛṃhite vastuni | atra saptamyantaiḥ śuddhacittattvasya kathanaṃ | prathamāntaiḥ tadrūpasya jagataḥ jñeyam | nanu kathaṃ pūrṇatvādiguṇayukte śuddhacittattve 'vasthānaṃ yuktam | nyūnasyādhike avasthānadarśanāt | sat-yam | avasthānam atrādheyabhāvena nāsti yenoktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ syāt | kiṃ tu tanmātratābhāveneti nātra doṣaprasaṅgaḥ | ity alaṃ prapañcaiḥ ||
na dṛśyam asti no dṛk ca na draṣṭā na ca darśanam /
jaḍaṃ no cic chāntam evedam ātatam //
sti | sarveṣāṃ eṣāṃ pratītimātrasāratvāt | nanu tarhi etad abhāva evāstī-ty | atrāha
sti | na hi sar-vathā asataḥ bhānaṃ yuktaṃ | śaśiśṛṅgāder api bhānāpatteḥ | nanu tarhi jāḍyam eva syāt | jāḍye hi sarveṣām
sti | tattve hi dṛśyādibhānam ayuktaṃ syāt | nanu tarhi śiṣṭā cid eva syād ity | atrāha
asti | cetyāpekṣatvena tasyāḥ sthitatvāt | cetyasya coktanyāyenāsambhavāt | nanu tarhi kim asti | na hi sarvathā asattā buddhyai ārohatīty | atrāha
atra niścayam anāpnuvan śrīrāmaḥ muneḥ asambhavārthābhidhāyitvam āsañjayati
iti prayogaḥ ārṣaḥ | sarvathā asambaddhārthābhidhāyy eva tava vacanam iti bhāvaḥ | asambhavārthapratipādakatvāropaprakāśitāvinayanirāsanārthaṃ
nāstīti kim idaṃ nāma bhavatāpi mamocyate //
ty etat satyam evāsti tarhi yuktaṃ
yathedaṃ na sthitaṃ viśvaṃ notpannaṃ na ca vidyate /
tathā kathaya me brahman yenaitan niścitaṃ bhavet //
| āravakārī vandhyāputra iva | yathā saḥ asat bhāti | tathety arthaḥ ||
idam ādāv anutpannaṃ sargādau tena nāsty alam /
idaṃ hi manasā bhāti svapnādau pattanaṃ yathā //
cinmātrasya cetyonmukhatārūpe sargārambhe | anudbhūtaṃ āsīt | paramārthataḥ cinmātrabhāvād acyuteḥ | tataḥ bhinnayā sattayāśritaṃ na āsīt | na hi bahir api
utpadyamānasya ghaṭasya mṛdaḥ bhinnā sattā dṛśyate |
cinmātrasākṣitāmātreṇa labdhasattākatvāt | nanu tarhi katham idaṃ bhāsate ity | atrāha
nanu satsvarūpeṇa manasā bhātasya dṛśyasya sattvaṃ yuktam evety | atrāha
nanu prakṛtaṃ dṛśyāsattvakathanaṃ vihāya mano'sattvakathanam ayuktam ity | atrāha
asatsvarūpam | asatā vistāryamāṇatvāt | na hy asatā vistāritaṃ sat bhavituṃ yogyam | vandhyāputravistāritasya vāgjālasyāpi sattāpatteḥ |
| tathety arthaḥ | dṛśyate hi svapne svapnāntaram iti nātra vivādaḥ ||
svāśrayabhūtaṃ dehaṃ praty api asyaiva kāraṇatvaṃ kathayati
tat svayaṃ svairam evāśu saṅkalpayati dehakam /
saṅkalpamātreṇa sampādayati | punar api prakṛtam eva kathayati
sphurati gacchati valgati yācate bhavati majjati saṃharati svayam /
aparatām upayāty api kevalaṃ calati cañcalaśaktitayā manaḥ //
upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | tena yā kācit kriyā iha bhavati sā manaḥkṛtā eva bhavatīti saṅkṣiptārtha iti śivam ||
iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyām utpattiprakaraṇe caturthaḥ sargaḥ ||
evaṃ manonirṇayam avaśyakartavyatayā śrutvā śrīrāmaḥ pṛcchati
bhagavan muniśārdūla kim iveha mano bhrame /
vidyate katham utpannaṃ mano māyāmayaṃ kutaḥ //
utpattim ādāv iti me samāsena vada prabho /
kathayiṣyasi | svayam eva śiṣṭatvād iti bhāvaḥ ||
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ sargādināśasākṣitākhyāt kṣobhād api niṣkrāntam kim apy anirvācyaṃ tattvam ev
śiṣṭam bhavati | atra sargaḥ svaviṣayaṃ padārthajātasākṣi
| saṃhāraḥ svasādhyam padārthābhāvaṃ | saṃskāraḥ padārthasaṃskāraṃ padārthābhāvaṃ | tayoḥ saṃskāraḥ padārthasaṃskāraṃ padārthābhāvasaṃskāraṃ ceti vibhāgo jñātavyaḥ ||
sarveṣāṃ paramārthataḥ ahantāviṣayatayā bhāsamānam kim apy āntaraṃ tattvam |
tiṣṭhati | prathamam mahāpralayasākṣibhāvena tadanantaram api yathā tathā kalpyamānānāṃ svābhāvānāṃ sākṣibhāvena sthitatvāt | atra
sthitasyātmanaḥ sthitivartamānatākathanaṃ pramātrapekṣayā prayuktatvāt na doṣāvaham | kathambhūtaḥ asau
yathā tathā kalpitasya svāstasyāpi grāhakatvena sthitatvāt phalataḥ astarahitaḥ |
sākṣitayā sarvaprakāśakatvāt sūryasvarūpaḥ | āścaryaṃ ca bhāsvataḥ anastamitatvam |
janmarahitaḥ | prādurbhūtiḥ hi janma | sā ca tasya na yuktā | ātmatvena sadā prādurbhūtatvāt | na hy ātmanaḥ aprādurbhūtatvaṃ kadāpi yuktam | svāprādurbhūter api grāhakatayā sthitatvāt |
krīḍāśīlaḥ | anyathā etādṛśaṃ jagat kathaṃ prādurbhavet | akrīḍāśīlo hi hastacālanamātrād api parāṅmukho bhavati |
niṣkrāntaḥ | anyathā māyākhyāmayagrastatvāt māyāprerakatvam ayuktam syāt | na hi āmayagrastaḥ āmayaprerako bhavati |
sarveṣu deśeṣu kāleṣu ca sarvakārī | anyathā anubhūyamānaḥ sarvadā sarvodbhavaḥ ayuktaḥ syāt |
paramaniyantā | anyathā sarve svasvabhāve niyatāḥ na syuḥ ||
yasya cātmādikāḥ sañjñāḥ kalpitā na svabhāvajāḥ //

| vāk hi saṅketaṃ puraskṛtya vastuni pravartate | saṅketaś ca paramātmani kartum aśakyaḥ | bāhyāntaḥkaraṇāgocaratvāt | indriyagocare eva vastuni hastagrāhikayā saṅketakaraṇaṃ dṛśyate | tarhi asau nāstīty | atrāha
eva dṛśyānāsaktacittaiḥ eva | na tu laukikaiḥ |

ātmatayā jñāyate | muktāḥ hi śuddhaṃ kim api tattvaṃ ātmatayā jānanti | anyathā muktatvāyogāt | tathā cāsattā asya na yukteti bhāvaḥ | nanu vācāṃ tataḥ nivartanakathanam ayuktaṃ ātmādiśabdānāṃ tadvācakatvāt ity | atrāha
nanu yadi saḥ eka evāsti tat kathaṃ sāṅkhyādibhiḥ puruṣādayaḥ kathitā ity | atrāha
puruṣam eva śeṣatvena kathayanti | sa ca vicāryamāṇaḥ uktaparamātmarūpatve eva viśrāmyatīti yuktam uktaṃ

iti | evaṃ sarvatra yojyam | tathā ca nāmabhedasyaiva sthitatvān noktadoṣaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | nanu śrīvasiṣṭhena kiṃ darśanam āśrityedaṃ śāstram uktam iti cet | satyam | sarveṣāṃ darśanānāṃ sāram āśritya etenedaṃ śāstraṃ kṛtam | anyathā sarvamatāṅgīkāraḥ ayuktaḥ syāt | bāhulyena vedāntaśāstracarcā atra dṛśyate | tadapekṣayā stokena mahārahasyabhūtasya śivaśāstrasyāpi ity alam aprakṛtacintanena |
vaktā smartā ṛtaṃ bhoktā draṣṭā kartā sadaiva yaḥ //
suṣuptau anubhūyamānaṃ na kiñcittvaṃ | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | tena sarveṣāṃ
yat vastu viśrāntisthānaṃ bhavati tad asāv eveti jñeyam | punaḥ kathambhūto 'sau bhavatīty | atrāha
citprakāśo hy ayaṃ yasmād āloka iva bhāsvataḥ //
bhavati | anyathākāśasthitānāṃ sūryādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt |
yasmād viṣṇvādayo devāḥ sūryād iva marīcayaḥ /
yasmāj jaganty anantāni budbudā jaladher iva //
cādhyātmikāḥ ādhidaivikāś ceti dvividhāḥ jñeyāḥ | tatra ādhidaivikāḥ prasiddhāḥ | ādhyātmikā yathā | manaḥ brahmā | buddhiḥ
api evaṃ dvividhāni jñeyāni | tāny api ādhidaivikāni prasiddhāni | ādhyātmikāni tu
ya ātmānaṃ padārthaṃ ca prakāśayati dīpavat //
ākāśe yaḥ śarīre ca dṛśatsv apsu latāsu ca /
pāṃsuṣv adriṣu vāteṣu pātāleṣu ca saṃsthitaḥ //

bhavati | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | tena sarvatra sthāvare sthita iti jñeyam | sthāvareṣu sthitatvaṃ ātmanaḥ katham astīti cet | satyam | sarve sthāvarāḥ tāvat vicāryamāṇāḥ anirvācyatāyām eva viśrāmyanti | anirvācyatā eva ca ātmanaḥ svarūpam iti na kaścid virodhaḥ | atha vā sthāvarāḥ tāvat ātmayuktāḥ nirātmakāḥ vā | nirātmakatve kiṃrūpatvaṃ teṣāṃ syāt | sātmakatve tu sphuṭam eva teṣv ātmanaḥ avasthānam iti yojyam ||
yaḥ plāvayati saṃrabdhaṃ puryaṣṭakam itas tataḥ /
yatra tatra gamayati | ceṣṭāṃ kārayatīti yāvat |
bhavanti | atyantajaḍā iva bhavantīti yāvat | mūḍhānām api paramārthataḥ śuddhacinmātrarūpatvāt
vyoma yena kṛtaṃ śūnyaṃ śailā yena ghanīkṛtāḥ /
āpo drutāḥ kṛtā yena dīpto yasya vaśād raviḥ //
sphuranty avirataṃ yasmin ghṛṇāv iva marīcayaḥ //
yathā tathā sambhāvitasya svanāśasyāpi sākṣitayā sthitatvāt vināśarahitaḥ |
bhavati | nāśabhāvenāpi sthitatvāt | anyathā ātmarahitasya nāśasya kena rūpeṇa bhānaṃ syāt | tathā
bhavati | sāratayā sthitatvāt | viruddhaṃ ca avināśinaḥ vināśarūpatvam sarvabhāvavyatiriktasya
jaganmūlakāraṇabhūtaṃ kim api tattvam | sā eva
kāryabhāvena pariṇāme kartṛtvaṃ bhajati | anyathā kāryavargagatajaḍatvānyathānupapattyā jaḍarūpāyāḥ tasyāḥ kāryabhāvena pariṇāmaṃ prati kartṛtvāyogāt |
yasyāḥ | sā | tādṛśī | cittamūlatvena prakṛteḥ pratītimātrasiddhatvamātram uktam iti brahmāṇḍamūlakāraṇabhūtāyāḥ prakṛteḥ kathaṃ tadantargatapuruṣacinmātramūlatvam uktam iti na paryanuyojyam ||
cid eva maṇiḥ | prakāśakatvāt ratnam | tatsvarūpaḥ
jīvabhāvena sphura-ti | anyathā dehāntargatānāṃ jīvānāṃ kiṃrūpatvaṃ syāt | yuktaṃ ca samudgake ratnaprakacanam |

| anyathā kimādhāram āsāṃ bhānaṃ syāt | na hi nirādhārasya jagajjālasya sphuraṇaṃ buddhim ārohati | marīcitvaṃ ca jagajjālasya citprakāśaviṣayatvena citprakāśatānapāyāj jñeyam | acidrūpo hi cidviṣayatāyogyo na bhavati | viruddhatvena tatsānnidhye tasya sannidhānāsambhavāt ||
| yuktaṃ ca jalavarṣiṇi meghe dhārājalānāṃ taḍitāṃ ca sphuraṇam | ānandavarṣitvaṃ cātmanaḥ
bhavati | ānandavarṣiṇi putrādau eva premāspadatvadarśanāt | ātmanaḥ
ānandam anubhavanti | yaddarśanam eva teṣāṃ camatkārakāraṇam astīti yāvat | mithyā iti sāmānyākṣepeṇoktam | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | bhoktāraḥ tāvat
bhogyān anubhūya bhogyāntaranirapekṣā jāyante | anyathā tatkālaṃ viṣayīkṛtasya
bhogaḥ samāptiṃ na vrajet | tatkālaṃ bhogyāntaranirapekṣatvaṃ ca tatra teṣāṃ camatkārānubhavanaṃ vinā na

| ekasmin viṣaye anubhūyamānena camatkāreṇaiva hi puruṣaḥ anyeṣu viṣayeṣu nirapekṣo bhavati | sa ca camatkāraḥ vicāryamāṇaḥ nairapekṣyakāraṇatvāt ātmasvarūpa eva bhavati | paramaviśrāntipadasvarūpasya ātmana eva nairapekṣyakāraṇatvāt iti yuktam eva bhoktuḥ bhogyeṣu yaddarśanarūpaṃ
iti | anubhavamātragamye 'smin vastuni pratibhāvadbhiḥ svayam api yatanīyam ity alaṃ prapañcena | tathā
niyatir deśakālau ca calanaṃ spandanaṃ kriyāḥ /
kenāpi rūpeṇa niṣṭhāṃ na gatā | yā
āśrayaṇam arthaḥ | ghaṭatve niṣṭhitaḥ ghaṭaḥ paṭatāṃ na yātīti
mahatām jagatām anantaspandam kurvan api iva
yathā tathā kalpitasya svāstamayasyāpi sākṣitvenāvasthānāt paramārthataḥ astamayarahitā | yā
yena | saḥ | tādṛśaḥ | jagataḥ udaye sthitau arthāt saṃhāre ca nirapekṣa ity arthaḥ | iti śivam ||
iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyām utpattiprakaraṇe pañcamaḥ sargaḥ ||
oṃ evaṃ paramātmanaḥ svarūpaṃ māhātmyaṃ ca pratipādya śrīrāmaṃ tatprāptiṃ prati tvaramāṇaṃ jñātvā sugamaṃ tatprāptyupāyaṃ kathayati
jñānād eva parā siddhir na tv
nanv anuṣṭhānaṃ vinā kathaṃ yuktatā syād ity | atrāha
atra jñānam anuṣṭhānaṃ na tv anyad upayujyate /
| asyāstīti tādṛśaṃ bhavati | samyagjñānarūpaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ ||
nanv īdṛśo 'sāv ātmā kutra tiṣṭhatīty | atrāha
na caiṣa dūre nākāśe nālabhyo viṣamo na ca /
bhavati | sadā labdhatvāt | anyathā ātmatvāyogyatvāt | etena durlabhatvaśaṅkā
bhavati | parapremāspadatvāt | na hi kaṭhine premāspadatvaṃ yuktam | paratvaviśeṣitasya tu premnaḥ kā kathā | etena aiśvaryaleśamadagrastarājādivat krauryāśaṅkā nivāritā | puruṣeṇa
nanu tapaḥprabhṛtināpi kecid ātmaprāptiṃ kathayantīty | atrāha
na karoti | bāhyāṅgatvena ārādupakārakatvāt | tapaḥprabhṛtinā hi sattvaśuddhir eva bhavati | nātmaprāptiḥ |
jagati jagattvajñānākhyasya mithyājñānaprapañcasya | lakṣaṇayā jagati jagattvajñānākhyasya mohajālayuktasya puruṣasy
ayaṃ sa deva ity eva samparijñānamātrataḥ /
jantor na jāyate duḥkhaṃ jīvanmuktatvam eti ca //
ahantayā idantayā ca puraḥsphuraṇaśīlaḥ ahaṅkārādikaḥ saṃsāraḥ |
sādhanabhāvena prasiddhasya tapaḥprabhṛtikasyāsādhanatvam asahamānaḥ ātmanaḥ sulabhatve nikaṭavartitve ca sandihānaś ca śrīrāmaḥ pṛcchati
punar doṣā na bādhante maraṇādyāḥ kadācana //
anena ātmanā maraṇādyāḥ doṣāḥ na bādhante
tarhi jñātajñeyatvena maunam eva kurv ity | atrāha
devadevo mahān eṣa kuto dūrād avāpyate /
tapasā kena tīvreṇa kleśena kiyatātha vā //
kena tīvreṇa tapasā avāpyata atha vā kiyatā kleśena
| na hi īdṛśasya devadevasya tapaādikaṃ prāṇarodhanādikaṃ ca vinā prāptiḥ yujyate | sarveṣāṃ tatprāptiprasaṅgāt | na hi sarve tatprāptibhājaḥ dṛśyante | na cānavāptasya
yuktaṃ | prāptasya ghaṭāder eva tadviṣayatādarśanād iti bhāvaḥ ||
vikāsayuktena vicāreṇa | ko 'ham idaṃ jagac ca kim ity evaṃrūpeṇa

ity anena jñānamātram evātra sādhanīyaṃ | nāvāptiḥ | na hi puraḥsthāyāṃ śuktau rajatabhramayuktasya śuktyavāptiṃ kāṅkṣamāṇasyāpi śuktyavāptiḥ sadhanīyā | śuktir eveyam ity evaṃrūpasya jñānamātrasyaiva sādhanīyatvāt iti dyotitam |
rāgādiyuktasya tapaādeḥ sphuṭam eva asādhanatvam | tadrahitasya tu sādhanatve 'pi rāgādirāhityasyaiva sādhanatvaṃ yuktam ity abhiprāyeṇāha
vinā rāma tapodānaṃ kleśa eva na vāstavam //
yad arjyate tato dānād yasyārthas tasya tat phalam //
rāgādyupahate citte vratādi kriyate ca yat /
sa dambhaḥ procyate tasya phalam asti manāṅ na vā //
nanu tat pauruṣaṃ kīdṛg astīty | atrāha
śṛṇu tat pauruṣaṃ kīdṛg ātmajñānasya labdhaye /
| anyathā ātmajñānalabdhihetutvaṃ tasya na syād iti bhāvaḥ ||
| kim u vaktavyaṃ tasya śīghraṃ mokṣaḥ kathaṃ syād iti bhāvaḥ ||
nanu prathamaṃ tāvat tvayā sādhusaṅgatir evopāyatvenoktā | sa sādhur eva kaḥ syād yasya saṅgatiḥ kriyate ity | atrāha
bhṛśaṃ yaṃ sujanaprāyaṃ lokāḥ sādhuṃ pracakṣate /
sa viśiṣṭaḥ sa sādhuḥ syāt taṃ prayatnena saṃśrayet //
padenāsādhutve 'pi | prayojanavaśād bāndhavaiḥ uktasujanatve puruṣe sādhutve 'pi paranindaikarasikakhalajanaproktāsādhujanatve puruṣe sādhutvāsādhutvayoḥ nirāsaḥ ||
śāstraṃ sacchāstram ity āhur mucyate tadvicāravān //
saṃsārakṛtāt bandhanāt mukto bhavati | ataḥ adhyātmaśāstram evātropayuktam astīti bhāvaḥ ||
sacchāstrādeḥ utpannasya vivekasya mukhyopāyatvaṃ sargāntaślokena sphuṭīkṛtya kathayati
iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyām utpattiprakaraṇe ṣaṣṭhaḥ sargaḥ ||
dūradeśagamanaṃ upāyajālaprayogaṃ ca vinātmāvāptim amanyamānaḥ śrīrāmaḥ punar api pūrvoktam eva praśnaṃ karoti
ya eṣa devaḥ kathito yasmiñ jñāte vimucyate /
vada kvāsau sthito devaḥ katham enam ahaṃ
kathito (naiṣa dūre 'vatiṣṭhate śarīre saṃsthito nityaṃ cinmātram iti viśrutaḥ) *yasmin ...
ya eṣa devaḥ kathito naiṣa dūre 'vatiṣṭhate /
śarīre saṃsthito nityaṃ cinmātram iti viśrutaḥ //
bhavati | anyathā pāṣāṇatulyasya śarīrasyāpi mṛtaśarīravat ceṣṭāśrayatvaṃ na syāt | na ca śarīrasthasya dūrasthatvaṃ vaktuṃ yuktaṃ | svahastayor api
nanu tarhi dehaparimāṇaḥ evāsau syāt | tathā ca dehavad anityatvam apy asya syād ity | atrāha
eṣa sarvam idaṃ viśvaṃ na viśvaṃ tv eṣa sarvagaḥ /
vidyate hy eṣa evaiko na tu viśvābhidhāsti dṛk //
etadrūpatvānapāyāt | na hi taraṅgākrānte jale taraṅgābhidhā dṛk bhavati | bhāsamāneṣv api taraṅgeṣu vivekijanadṛṣṭyā jalatvānapāyāt ||
bhavati | nanu katham etad iti cet | satyaṃ |

sacetano 'sti cetanārahito vā | acetanatve pāṣāṇarūpasya tasya jagadgatasyāvaratulyayogakṣematvam eva | sacetanatve tu sphuṭam cinmātram eva tadbhāvena sphurati | nanu tarhi śaśibhṛtkīṭayoḥ samatvam eva syād iti cet | kenoktaṃ nāstīti | nanu
bhedaḥ kalpyate | ayuktam eva kalpyate | na hi agnikaṇamahāgnicayayoḥ

bhedaḥ kalpayituṃ yuktaḥ | nanu agnikaṇamahāgnicayayoḥ kāryavailakṣaṇyaṃ nāsti dāhākhyasyaikasya kāryasya darśanāt iti cet | śaśibhṛtkīṭayor api | kiṃrūpaṃ kāryavailakṣaṇyam asti jñānakriyāyāḥ karaṇakriyāyāś caikatvāt | yas tu bahvalpatākṛto bhedaḥ asti | saḥ dṛṣṭānte 'py astīti na ko 'pi virodhaḥ | evam anyatrāpi yojyam |
bālā api vadanty etad yadi cetanamātrakam /
jagad ity eva kevātra nāma syād upadeśatā //
bhavati | etad eva satyaṃ bhavatīti yāvat | tadā
ity anena vijñānavādināṃ bauddhānāṃ grahaṇam | te eva hi vijñānāparaparyāyasya cetanasyātmatvaṃ kathayanti ||
cinmātraṃ cetanaṃ viśvam iti yaj jñātavān asi /
na kiñcid etad vijñātaṃ bhavatā bhavatāraṇam //
| cinmātrapadārthānabhijñatvāt | cinmātrapadārthajñānamātreṇaiva hi ca saṃsāraḥ naśyati ||
cetanaṃ nāma saṃsāro jīva eṣa paśuḥ smṛtaḥ /
bhavati | cinmātrasthasya cetyaunmukhyasyaiva cetanatvāt cetyaunmukhyasyaiva ca saṃsāratvāt |
hi saṃsaraṇam ucyate | saṃsaraṇaṃ ca svasthānāt utthānaṃ | cinmātrasya ca cetyaunmukhyasamaye śuddhacinmātratārūpāt svasthānāt utthānaṃ bhavaty evānyathā cetyaunmukhyatvaṃ nāma kiṃ syāt | paṇḍitaiḥ

ca jīvanam eva | ataḥ tadvati tadupacārāt cetanasyaiva jīvatvam bhavati | tadvati tadupacārāśrayaṇaṃ tv atra paramārthataḥ śuddhacinmātrarūpasya jīvasya jīvatve jīvanakriyāvyatiriktasādhanāntarabuddhinirāsārthaṃ kṛtam | nanu tato 'pi kim ity | atrāh
paśur ajño hy amūrto 'pi duḥkhasyaivaiṣa bhājanam /
pātrabhūtaḥ | tadrūpatayā śuddhacinmātrāt utthānāt | anyathā utthānasyāpi vyarthatvāt | tathā
svasphūrtiviṣayaṃ karoti | cetanasya hy etad eva cetanatvaṃ yat kiñcic
ity uktam | nanu taccetanena kiṃ sampannam ity | atrāh
prādurbhūtaḥ | atra ca svapnasya dṛṣṭāntatvaṃ sphuṭam eveti nāyastam ||
nanv asya cetanasyedaṃ duḥkhaṃ kiṃ kadācic chrāmyed apīty | atrāha
asya sā bharitāvasthā tāṃ jñātvā nānuśocati //
prathamaṃ svātantryeṇa cetyābhimukhībhūya tataḥ vicāradvāreṇa tataḥ niṣkrāntiḥ |
saṃsārākhyaduḥkhabhāk na bhavati | bharitāvasthānena svasmin sthitāyāḥ cetanatāyāḥ asatyatvajñānena
nanu tadā asya cetanasya kīdṛśī avasthā bhaviṣyatīty | atrāha
paramārthataḥ ātmabhāvena niścite sati | asyāṃ bharitāvasthāyāṃ jñātāyām iti yāvat |
nanu tarhi atyantopādeyabhūtaṃ acetyonmukhatvam evāhaṃ sādhayāmīty | atrāha
roddhuṃ na śakyaṃ dṛśyaṃ tu cetyaṃ śāmyatu vai katham //
bhavati | na hi tūlapiṇḍe patitaḥ agniḥ śānto bhavati | nanu tarhi cetyam eva nāśayāmi ity | atrāha

| na śāmyaty eva sataḥ nāśāyogāt | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | cetyaṃ yadi asti tarhi kathaṃ śāmyet | yadi nāsti tadā cetyānaunmukhyaṃ svayam eva siddhaṃ bhavatīti | na tadāharaṇe jñānamātraṃ vinā prayatno yuktaḥ | na hi vandhyāputranāśacintā kenāpi kriyate iti ||
dṛśyate paramātmā yaḥ sa brahman vada kīdṛśaḥ //
yad etac cetanaṃ jīvo viśīrṇo janmajaṅgale /
etam ātmānam icchanti ye te 'jñāḥ paṇḍitā api //
etam ye ātmānam icchanti te paṇḍitāḥ api
tarhi kasya jñānena kiñcit prāptaṃ bhavatīty | atrāha
jñāyate paramātmā ced rāma tad duḥkhasantatiḥ /
gacchati | tadaiva kiñcit prāptaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ | kā
śrīrāmaḥ paramātmasvarūpaśravaṇākāṅkṣānirbharatvena kathanāyogyatvāc chrīvasiṣṭhenānādṛtam api ātmasvarūpapraśnaṃ punaḥ karoti
rūpaṃ kathaya me brahman yathāvat paramātmanaḥ /
deśād deśāntaraṃ dūraṃ prāptāyāḥ saṃvido vapuḥ /
nimeṣeṇaiva yan madhye tad rūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ //
ekasmin nimeṣe eva | na tu madhye mauḍhyam anubhūya |

tadaivottarasaṃvedyam ālambanīkurvantyāḥ saṃvidaḥ kim idaṃ madhyaṃ nāma yatrasthāyāḥ citaḥ paramātmarūpatā uktā | ucyate | pūrvasaṃvedyena rañjitāyāḥ saṃvidaḥ svaṃ nirmalaṃ rūpam aprāpyottarasaṃvedyena kariṣyamāṇasya rāgasyāyuktatvāt nirmalasvarūpatāmayaṃ madhyam avaśyam evāstīti jñātavyam | yathā nīlīrāgarañjitasya paṭasya
prakṣālaṇena sphuṭīkṛtaṃ śuddhapaṭatāmayaṃ madhyaṃ bhavati | anyathā kariṣyamāṇasya pītarāgasya karaṇāsambhavāt | nanu pūrvasaṃvedyaviṣayā saṃvit pūrvam eva kṣīṇā |
tu navīnā jātā | tathā ca madhyaṃ nāma śūnyam evāstīti | kiṃ śūnyarūpa evātmāstīti cet | na | uttarasaṃvedyagrahaṇakāle
| na hi pūrvasaṃvedyagrahaṇakālasthāṃ madhye śuddharūpatayā sthitāṃ uttarasaṃvedyagrahaṇakāle 'pi sthitām ekāṃ saṃvidam antareṇa

smṛtiḥ upapadyate | etena saṃvedyoparāgarahitaṃ jāḍyārūṣitaṃ saṃvittattvaṃ paramātmatvenoktam | atra cābhyāsaṃ kurvatām acirād ayatnenaiva paramātmalābho bhaviṣyaty | asyaiva ca madhyadhāmāveśa iti nāmāstīty alaṃ rahasyodghāṭanena | atra ca sadṛśayoḥ saṃvedyayoḥ madhyam atidurlabham iti
bhavati | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | mumukṣuḥ sacchāstrādibhiḥ prathamaṃ rajjusarpādidṛṣṭāntena tataḥ kanakakaṭakādidṛṣṭāntena dṛśyasya
niścitya śuddhacittattvaikye jātaniścayaḥ yadā abhyāsabalena sarvatra śuddhacittattvamātram evānubhavati suvarṇakāra iva kaṭakādiṣu suvarṇatām tadā tasya jñānam yatsvarūpaṃ bhavati tad eva

iti | nanu jagatpratiyogikaḥ atyantābhāvaḥ na sambhavati | pūrvaṃ bhūtatvāt jagataḥ jagadatyantābhāve niścitasyāpi hi pūrvaṃ jagad bhāsamānam āsīd eveti ced | asat etat | paurvakālikaṃ mithyābhānaṃ hi vastunaḥ uttarakāle niścitaṃ
na nihanti | pūrvaṃ rajjau bhāte sarpe 'pi atyantābhāvapratiyogitvaghātitvaprasaṅgāt | pūrvaṃ sarpatvena
rajjau tu sarve sarpasya traikālikātyantābhāvapratiyogitvaṃ sphuṭam eva paśyantīti na ko 'pi virodhaḥ ||
draṣṭṛdṛśyakramo yatra sthito 'py astam alaṃ gataḥ /
yad anākāśam ākāśas tad rūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ //
ayaṃ draṣṭā idaṃ dṛśyam ity evaṃrūpaḥ kramaḥ |
bhavati | nanu sthitasya draṣṭṛdṛśyakramasya katham anyasmin layasambhavaḥ | tathā cānena dvāreṇa paramātmasvarūpakathanam ayuktam eveti cen | na |
tāvat kasyacit sākṣiṇaḥ bhātau bhavataḥ na vā | na cet kathaṃ tarhi tayoḥ draṣṭṛdṛśyatve
| yathā tathā tatsiddhau api kathaṃ tayoḥ vyavasthā
cet tarhi tasmin layaḥ tayoḥ sukaraḥ eva | na hi svapnasākṣiṇam atikramya svapnabhāte draṣṭṛdṛśye kenāpi svarūpeṇa yukte sambhavataḥ iti na kaścid virodhaḥ | tathā
tad eva vastu | na tu tatsadṛśam anyat kiñcit |
aśūnyam iva yac chūnyaṃ yasmiñ śūnye jagat sthitam /
sargaughe sati yac chūnyaṃ tad rūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ //
kiñcid iva | bhavati | anyathā jagadrūpabhramādhiṣṭhānatvāsambhavāt | na hi asad vastu kasyacid adhiṣṭhānībhavitum arhati | vandhyāputrasyāpi maitrabhramādhiṣṭhānatvaprasaṅgāt | tathā
sattābhāk bhavati | mṛdīva ghaṭādayaḥ | anyathā jagataḥ kiṃrūpatvaṃ syāt iti bhāvaḥ | tathā
adhiṣṭheyatayā kāryatayā vā sthitiṃ bhajati sati |
eva ⟨tayā vā sthitiṃ bhajati sati yat śūnyam svavyatiriktavasturahitam eva⟩
| bhavati | na hi rajjau sarpāvasthānena mṛdi vā ghaṭāvasthānena svavyatiriktavastuyuktatvaṃ kalpayituṃ śakyate |
jaḍaṃ tv ajaḍam evāntas tad rūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ //
bhavati | mahājaḍam iva bhavati | atiśāntatvena svaparāmarśe 'pi svātantryeṇa vimukhatvāt |
jaḍam iva ity arthaḥ | idaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayam
| sākṣipratītau sphuraṇaṃ vinā hi sato 'pi nīlasukhādeḥ sattā asatkalpā eva dṛśyate |
tathedaṃ saṃsthitaṃ yatra tad rūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ //

bhavati | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | yathā bhāsamānaḥ ālokaḥ svapradhānatvena na kathyate | anyathā prakāśaguṇatvakathanānupapatteḥ | prakāśaś ca vicāryamāṇaḥ anirvācyatām evāvagāhate | tathā bhāsamānam idaṃ jagat api anirvācye kasmin citsārabhūte pradhāne sthitam iti jñeyam | yasmin tu sthitam asti tad eva paramātmā bhavatīti | nanv etaiḥ anumānagamyasya kasyāpi vastunaḥ paramātmatvaṃ sādhitam | tathā cāsau paramātmā kalpita iti jñeyam | anumānagamyasya kalpitatvāt | nirvikalpapratyakṣamātragamyasya svalakṣaṇasyaiva paramārthasattvād iti ced | asad etat | upadeśyasya pratikṣaṇaṃ madhyāvasthāsu ātmatvena pratyakṣaṃ sphuraṇaśīlam apy ātmatayā ajñātam paramātmasvarūpaṃ |
tavātmā bhavatīti na ko 'py atra pratibhāvataḥ prati anumānasparśaḥ | apratibhāvatāṃ tv atrādhikāra eva nāstīty alaṃ paradoṣaguṇavicāraṇena ||
syāt | jāgrati hi sthūlaṃ jagat sphurati | svapne svapnajagat | suṣuptau jāḍyam | etābhyaḥ vyatiriktā tu avasthā
| ayaṃ ca praśnaḥ sarvadā paramātmamayatvāsādanākāṅkṣiṇā śrīrāmeṇa jāgrati pratikṣaṇaṃ sphuramāṇāḥ
taj jñātaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ bhaven nānyena karmaṇā /
dṛśyātyantābhāvatas tu ṛte nānyā śubhā gatiḥ //
| prayatnasādhitasya abhāvasya pradhvaṃsābhāvatvād iti śuktau rajatātyantābhāvavat mṛdi
nanu samyagjñānadvāreṇa siddhasya dṛśyatvarūpajagadatyantābhāvasyaiva kathaṃ paramātmaprāptau upāyatvam astīty | atrāha
evam eva vartamānasya | na tu prayatnanāśitasya |
atyantābhāvasya sampattau | śuktau bhātarajatātyantābhāvavat mṛdi bhātaghaṭātyantābhāvavad vā siddhau satyāṃ |
śeṣatvena sthito bhavati | rajatātyantābhāvajñāne iva śuktiḥ ghaṭātyantābhāvajñāne iva vā mṛt | tadvyatirekeṇānyasya kasyāpy asattvāt tataḥ puruṣeṇ
na cid apratibimbāsti dṛśyābhāvād ṛte kvacit /
bhavati | svabhāvatyāgaprasaṅgāt | atra samarthakaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ kathayati |

dṛśyate iti bhāvaḥ | nanv anyadeśasthe bimbe sattāṃ bhajaty api ādarśaḥ pratibimbarahitaḥ dṛśyate | tathā bahiḥ dṛśyasattā bhavatu | prāṇarodhādidvāreṇa bahiḥ aprasarantī cit dṛśyasparśarahitā bhaviṣyatīti cet | asad etat | atyantābhāvajñānaṃ vinā dṛśyabījasya nāśayitum aśakyatvāt | anyathā nidritasyāntaḥ svapnaprapañcabhānaṃ na syāt | nanu tasya prāṇarodhādyupāyarāhityāt svapnapratibhānam astīti cet | tarhi dṛśyātyantābhāvajñānahīnān kapaṭarahitān prāṇarodhādikāriṇaḥ eva pṛccha | kiṃ yuṣmākaṃ svapnapratibhānam asti na veti | nanu kapaṭarahitāḥ dṛśyātyantābhāvajñānayuktā api asmābhiḥ pṛṣṭā eva | tair api svasya svapnapradarśakatvam uktam | ucyatāṃ nāma kā hāniḥ | yathā jāgrati bhāsata eva jagataḥ atyantābhāvajñānaṃ
asti tathā svapne 'pi | na hi te bhāsamānam eva dṛśyaṃ dṛśyatayā paśyanti | kiṃ tu brahmatayety alaṃ prapañcena ||
nanu tathāpi dṛśyātyantābhāvena vinaivātmatattvaṃ paśyāma ity | atrāha
budhyate paramaṃ tattvaṃ na kadācana kenacit //
na jñāyate | tasmāt dṛśyātyantābhāvaḥ samyagjñānopāyena sādhyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ ||
mune katham asattāsti kva meruḥ sarṣapodare //
astīti kenacid ukte sati | tasmin asambhavārthapratipādakatvam eva viśrāmyati | tathā jagataḥ sattā nāstīti pratipādake tvayy apīti bhāvaḥ ||
dināni katicid rāma yadi tiṣṭhasy akhinnadhīḥ /
pramārjayāmi te dṛśyaṃ bodho mṛgajalaṃ yathā /
anudvignamatiḥ san | saṃmukhadhīḥ sann iti yāvat |
pramārjayati | tathety arthaḥ | anena sādhusaṅgādeḥ dṛśyātyantābhāvajñānaṃ prati mukhyam upāyatvam uktam | nanu dṛśyamārjanena kiṃ setsyatīty | atrāha
layaṃ vrajet | nanu tarhi abhāva eva śiṣyate ity | atrāha
avaśiṣṭaṃ bhavati | anyathā siddhasyāpi dṛśyātyantābhāvasya asatkalpatvaṃ syāt ||
nanu kathaṃ dṛśyamātrātyantābhāvenaiva draṣṭṛtā śāntiṃ vrajatīty | atrāha
draṣṭṛtvaṃ sati dṛśye 'smin dṛśyatvaṃ saty avekṣake /
ekatvaṃ sati hi dvitve dvitvaṃ caikatvavedane //

paramārthataḥ śuddhacinmātrasvarūpadraṣṭṛviṣayaḥ draṣṭṛbhāvaḥ syāt | viṣayasadbhāvena dṛśikriyāṃ prati kartṛtvasambhavāt | taṇḍulādiṣu hi satsu tadviṣayāṃ pākakriyāṃ prati kartṛtvaṃ bhajataḥ puruṣasyaiva pācakatvaṃ bhavati | na kevalaṃ dṛśyasattayā draṣṭuḥ eva draṣṭṛtā bhavati | api tu
paramārthataḥ śuddhacinmātrasvarūpadṛśyāśrayaḥ dṛśyabhāvaḥ syāt | na hi pācakena pākakriyāviṣayīkṛtaṃ taṇḍulādikam odanāvasthādyaparaparyāyaṃ
| ataḥ anyo'nyāpekṣatvena dṛśyamātrātyantābhāvena draṣṭṛviṣayā draṣṭṛtā naśyaty eveti bhāvaḥ | draṣṭṛtvadṛśyatvānyo'nyāśrayakathanaprasaṅgena tayoḥ ekatvadvitvayor api anyo'nyāśrayaṃ kathayati
mukhyatayā pūrvaṃ gaṇanārhe draṣṭari gatam ekatvam |
sattāṃ bhajati sati | syāt | dvitvābhāve gaṇanasyaiva apravṛtteḥ | gaṇanaṃ hi
vīkṣyaiva vyavasthātuṃ pravartate | dvitvādyabhāve tu kimarthaṃ tasya pravartanaṃ syāt | vyavasthāyāḥ svayaṃ vṛttau ca tatprathamāvayavabhūtasya ekatvasya sphuṭā evāsiddhiḥ | tathā
ekatvākāre vedane | draṣṭṛgate ekatve iti yāvat |
| syāt | ekaṃ vigaṇayyaiva dvitīyo gaṇanaviṣayatāṃ yātīti sphuṭā eva hi ekatvaṃ vinā dvitvasya
ekābhāve dvayor eva siddhir bhavati nātra hi /
nanv etāvataḥ dṛśyasya pramārjanaṃ kathaṃ kartuṃ śaknoṣīty | atrāha
nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ | /
yat tu nāsti svabhāvena kaḥ kleśas tatpramārjane //
| svarūpahāniprasaṅgāt | na ca svarūpahāniḥ yuktā | agner api agnitvahāniprasaṅgāt |
bhavati | na hi śaśiśṛṅgatroṭane kasyāpi yatnaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ ||
jagad ādāv anutpannam yac cedaṃ dṛśyate tatam /
tat svātmany eva vimale brahma cittvāt
bhavati | ataḥ jagatpramārjane kleśo nāstīti bhāvaḥ | nanu yadi jagat prathamam evānutpannaṃ
tarhi kim idaṃ bhāsata ity | atrāha
atiśayena bṛṃhāgataṃ bhavati | anyathā brahmatvāyogāt | bṛṃhāyuktam eva hi brahmocyate | na ca vastuni bṛṃhaṇaṃ nāmānyavastunaḥ utpattiḥ vaktuṃ śakyate |
'pi dravatvāt prādurbhūtasya taraṅgatayā bṛṃhaṇasyānyavastūtpattitvaprasaṅgāt | na ca mūrkho 'pi jale taraṅgānām anyatvam aṅgīkaroti | cidrūpasyātmana eva svapnapadārthabhāvena bṛṃhaṇaṃ dṛṣṭam iti
jagan nāma na cotpannaṃ na cāsti na ca dṛśyate /
nāsti | hemnaḥ eva tadrūpatayā sthitatvāt | tathā ity arthaḥ | ataḥ
śramaḥ kiṃ bhavati | brahmatājñānamātreṇaiva pramārjitatvāt | na hi hemni bhāsamānaṃ kaṭakāditvaṃ aśakyapramārjanaṃ bhavati | hematājñānamātreṇaiva tasya pramārjitatvāt ||
etāvata āśvāsarahitaṃ śiṣyaṃ jñātvā tasya samāśvāsanaṃ karoti
ādāv eva hi notpannaṃ yat tasyehāstitā
kuto marau jalasarid dvitīyendau kuto grahaḥ //
yathā vandhyāsuto nāsti yathā nāsti marau jalam /
tarhi kim idaṃ bhāsate ity | atrāha
yad idaṃ dṛśyate rāma tad brahmaiva nirāmayam /
etat purastād vakṣyāmo yuktito na giraiva vaḥ //
kaṣṭāvaho bhavati taṃ vidur ajñam eva //
kaṣṭadāyī | asambhavaprayatnair ātmana iti śeṣaḥ | iti śivam ||
iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyām utpattiprakaraṇe saptamaḥ sargaḥ ||
kayaitaj jñāyate yuktyā katham etat prasidhyati /
dṛśyāsatyatvam | nanu kimartham atra yuktiṃ pṛcchasīty | atrāha
jagannāmnī vicārākhyād ṛte mantrān na śāmyati //
buddhau satyatayā sphuritā | jagataś ca mithyājñānarūpatvaṃ śuktirajatavaj jñeyam | yuktaś ca
vadāmy ākhyāyikā rāma yā imā bodhasiddhaye /
tāś cec chṛṇoṣi tat sādho mukta evāsi buddhimān //
nanu dṛḍhatayā śravaṇenāpi yadi kiñcin na setsyati tadā kiṃ kāryam ity | atrāha
yo yam arthaṃ prārthayate tadarthaṃ yatate tathā /
so 'vaśyaṃ tad avāpnoti na cec chrānto nivartate //
nanv aham asmin prārthite vastuni kiṃrūpaṃ yatnaṃ karomīty | atrāha
tad dinair eva vā māsaiḥ prāpnoṣi paramaṃ padam //
śrīvasiṣṭhasādhutve niścitaḥ śrīrāmaḥ ātmajñānaprabodhanimittaṃ śāstraṃ pṛcchati

ayam mahārāmāyaṇākhyaḥ itihāsaḥ | nanu śrīvālmīkinā svenopanibaddhe śrīmahārāmāyaṇe śrīrāmavṛttāntakathanaprasaṅgataḥ śrīrāmaṃ prati śrīvasiṣṭhena kṛtaḥ upadeśaḥ nibaddhaḥ yaḥ kenāpi dayālunā asmāc chrīmahārāmāyaṇād
ity anena parāmarśaḥ kṛtaḥ | anena hi śrīmahārāmāyaṇasya śrīvasiṣṭhakṛtatvaṃ dyotate iti cet |

evāsmābhiḥ ayaṃ nirṇayaḥ kṛtaḥ | kiṃ punaḥ punaḥ pṛcchasi | yataḥ tatra pratibhāvatāṃ svayam asyārthasyāvabodhakatvaṃ uktam | tadrahitānāṃ tv anadhikāraḥ uktaḥ | iti pratibhām eva pṛccha | yadi na pratibhā asti tadānadhikāritvān maunam eva kāryam ity alaṃ prapañcena ||
yathā svapne parijñāte svapnārthād eva bhāvanā //
na tu mudgarādiprahāraiḥ nāśaṃ nītam | atra dṛṣṭāntam āha

kāraḥ pādapūraṇārthaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | yathā svapne jāgradavasthāyāṃ asatyatayā parijñāte sati | tatrānubhūtaiḥ bhāvābhāvaiḥ harṣāmarṣau na jñāyete | anyathā hi jāgraty anubhūtair atītair api bhāvābhāvair iva tatratyaiḥ bhāvābhāvaiḥ harṣāmarṣotpādaḥ syāt | tathā mahārāmāyaṇavicāraṇena dṛśye asatyatayā jñāte sati dṛśyaviṣayaiḥ bhāvābhāvaiḥ harṣāmarṣau na jñāyete iti ||
eva | tat katham asyaivāsādhāraṇakāraṇatvaṃ kathayasīty | atrāha
yad ihāsti tad anyatra yan nehāsti na tat kvacit /
bālasyāpi paraṃ bodhaṃ buddhir eti na saṃśayaḥ //
mūrkhasyāpīty arthaḥ | paṇḍitasya tu kā katheti bhāvaḥ ||
yasmai nedaṃ tv abhavyāya rocate duṣkṛtodayāt /
nanu muktikāmasya mama kim etacchravaṇenety | atrāha
śrūyamāṇe hi śāstre 'smiñ śrotā vetty etad ātmanā /
yathāvad idam asmābhir na tūktaṃ varaśāpavat //
maduktaṃ vastu | nanu yady etacchravaṇe pravṛttasya kiñcit pratyavāyādi syāt tadā kiṃ kāryam ity | atrāha
| ataḥ bhavitavyam iti śeṣaḥ | ataḥ kāraṇāt puruṣeṇa | tasya
kathanavyatiriktāni yatnaśatāni | yena | saḥ | tādṛśena bhavitavyam | iti śivam ||
kathayantaś ca taṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ramayanti ye //
brūhi yena tathaivāhaṃ yate śāstradṛśā dhiyā //
astaṃ gataṃ sthitaṃ vyoma sa jīvanmukta ucyate //
anena prakāreṇaiva sthitam | na tu kenāpi prayatnena nāśitasvarūpaṃ |
| bhāsamānasya jagataḥ śuktikārajatavat asatyatvadarśitvaṃ jīvanmuktalakṣaṇam iti bhāvaḥ ||
ya āste vyavahartaiva sa jīvanmukta ucyate //
eva sataḥ suṣuptavad avasthitir iti nāyastam ||
yo jāgarti suṣuptastho yasya jāgran na vidyate /
yasya nirvāsano bodhaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate //
suṣuptau iva tiṣṭhatīti | tādṛśaḥ | ekacinmātratāniścayena bāhyaprapañcānusandhānarahitatvāt | tathā
turyamayatvāt | jīvanmukto hi jāgrati sarvaṃ cinmātramayaṃ paśyan turyāvasthāviṣṭa eva bhavati | tathā
yo 'ntar vyomavad atyacchaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate //
| rāgādhāre putrādau ratiṃ bhajan api | dveṣādhāre śatrau vimukho bhavan api | bhayakāraṇāt siṃhādeḥ calan api |
| anusandhāna eva hi manasi malaṃ bhavati | paṇḍitaiḥ
yasya nāhaṅkṛto bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate | /
lepayuktā na kriyate | rāgādirūpaiḥ pāpair iti śeṣaḥ | paṇḍitaiḥ
śarīrayātrānimittaṃ pravāhāgataṃ vā karma kurvataḥ | tathā kenāpi kāraṇena
vā | tatra karaṇakāle niranusandhānakaraṇāt akaraṇakāle śuddhacinmātraparāmarśaniṣṭhatvāt ahambhāvadhīleparāhityaṃ jñeyam ||
paśyet trilokyāḥ khasamaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate //
| tathā ca unmeṣeṇa sambhavaḥ | nimeṣeṇa pralayaḥ | iti yathāsaṅkhyaṃ vihāyaiva sambandhaḥ kāryaḥ ||
buddhaḥ supta ivāste 'ntaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate //
svasmin śuddhabodhatājñānena bhoktāham ity abhimānābhāvāt | paṇḍitaiḥ
nityaṃ draṣṭaiva cādraṣṭā jīvann eva mṛtopamaḥ /
dṛśikriyākartṛtvaṃ bhajann eva | na tv andhavat tiṣṭhan |
bhavati | mṛtasadṛśaḥ bhavati | mṛtavat bhogādivāñchābhāvāt | tathā yaḥ
yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate ca yaḥ /
niṣprayojanatvāt | svaprayojanaparaḥ eva hi yebhyaḥ svaprayojanaṃ na paśyati tebhyaḥ udvijate |
yaḥ sacitto 'pi niścittaḥ sa jīvanmukta ucyate //
kalābhyaḥ niṣkrāntaḥ bhavati | svasya niṣkalacinmātratājñānāt | tathā
parārtheṣv iva pūrṇātmā sa jīvanmukta ucyate //
kim ayaṃ sidhyati na veti santāparahitaḥ bhavati | keṣv
cid yāty adehamuktatvaṃ pavanaḥ spandanām iva //
videhamukto nodeti nāstam eti na śāmyati /
na san nāsan na dūrasthaṃ na cāhaṃ na ca vetarat //
anahambhāvena gṛhītasya dehasyāpy abhāvena videhamuktiṃ gataḥ puruṣaḥ |
| yathā tathā kalpitasya tadastasya tataḥ evotthānāt | anyathāsambhavāt | tathā
bhavati | etādṛkprapañcabhāvena bhānābhāvaprasaṅgāt | na hi śaśaśṛṅgaṃ kenāpi rūpeṇa
bhavati | paricchinnaḥ pramātā na bhavati | aparimitapramātṛtvena sthitatvāt | tathā
sūryo bhūtvā pratapati viṣṇuḥ pāti jagattrayam /
rudraḥ sarvān saṃharati sarvān sṛjati padmajaḥ //
rakṣati | evaṃ sarvatra yojyam | eṣāṃ sūryādīnāṃ ca bāhyāntaratvena dvaividhyaṃ jñeyam | bāhye hi
yaḥ vyomni dṛśyate | āntaras tu prāṇaḥ | sūryavat śarīrapākakāritvāt | tathā
ahaṅkāraḥ | tadvat sarvasaṅkalpānāṃ svasmin layīkaraṇāt | tathā
manaḥ | tadvat saṅkalpotpādakatvāt | evaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ sarvatra yojyam | nanu kathaṃ videhamuktaḥ sūryādicarācarapadārthabhāvam āgatya tadgatāḥ sarvāḥ
karotīti cet | satyam | tatra carāḥ tāvat sphuṭam eva
lakṣyante | anyathā maraṇāvasthāṃ gateṣv api teṣu prāgvat kriyādhāratvaprasaṅgāt | nanu tatkriyāyāṃ prāṇa eva prerakaḥ dṛśyate | niṣprāṇānām
niṣkriyatvadarśanāt | asad etat | na hi prāṇo nāmātra prerakatve
kaścic cetana iva lakṣyate | kiṃ tv anyasya kasyāpi svatantrasya cetanasya preraṇayā |

nirgamapraveśakārīva dṛśyate iti śuddhasya cinmātrasyaiva carāntaryāmitvena caragatakriyākartṛtvaṃ jñāyate | acareṣv api dṛśyamāṇā avasthitikriyā kriyātvāt caragatakriyāvat tatkṛtā eva jñeyā | yataḥ yatra sākṣāc cetanatayā bhāsamānānāṃ carāṇāṃ svakriyāyām asāmarthyam asti tatra sākṣāj jaḍatvena bhāsamānānāṃ acarāṇāṃ kā kathā kriyākāritve | tena yathā adhiṣṭhātṛbhūtena devadattena kvacit sthāpitāḥ stambhādayaḥ
tathā svāntargatena kenāpi tattvena sthāpitāḥ acarāḥ tiṣṭhantīti jñeyam | tatra devadattasya tebhyaḥ

dṛśyate iti na tatra tasya tadantargatatvaṃ kalpyate | atra tu bahiḥ sthūlasya kasyāpy adarśanāt tadantargatatvaṃ kalpyate | bahirgatatvam api tasya na virudhyate ity āstām etat | evaṃ ca śuddhacinmātre paryavasitaṃ sarvakriyākartṛtvaṃ tanmayatāgate tasminn api siddham eva | samudre līnasya jalabindoḥ iva samudraguṇaviśiṣṭatvam | avaśiṣṭaṃ mṛtaśarīram api

eva jñeyam | nanu tathāpi videhamuktaḥ sarvāḥ kriyāḥ karotīty etāvanmātram eva siddham | na tu sarvaṃ bhūtvety etat siddham | tatra kā vārteti cet | satyam | tatreyaṃ vārtā | carācarāḥ bhāvāḥ kimmayāḥ iti vicāryamāṇe tatsvarūpaṃ hastagrāhābhāvāt anirvācyatāyām eva viśrāmyati | anirvācyatā eva ca śuddhacittattvasya svarūpam iti śuddhacidrūpatāṃ gatasya videhamuktasya sarvabhāvo yukta eveti na ko 'pi virodhaḥ | etac ca śuddhacittattvasvarūpam anubhavatsu pratyakṣasiddham eva | tadavidvadarthe tu ayaṃ prayatnaḥ kṛta ity alaṃ prapañcena ||
tejaḥ prakaṭayaty āśās tanoty āndhyaṃ tamo bhavat /
śūnyaṃ sad vyomatām eti giriḥ san rodhayaty alam //
| yuktaṃ cārkasya prakāśe trasareṇvoghavisāraṇaṃ śāntam avasthānaṃ ca ||
yat kiñcid idam ābhāti bhātaṃ vā bhām upaiṣyati /
kālatrayagataṃ dṛśyaṃ tad asau sarvam eva vā //
katham evaṃ vada brahman bhūyate viṣamā hi me /
nirvāṇam etat kathitaṃ śṛṇu samprāpyate katham //
sato 'py asyāpy anutpattyā buddhyā vaitad avāpyate //
anutpannam evedam ity evaṃrūpasya abhāvasya jñānenaiva | tajjagadviṣayānutpannatvajñāneneti yāvat |
śabdau evaśabdārthe | etena dṛśyātyantābhāvasya videhamuktiṃ prati kāraṇatvam uktam ||
manye te sargatām eva gatā vedyavidāṃ vara //
sargabhāvam eva gatāḥ bhavanti | sargāntargatapadārthabhāvenaiva sphuraṇāt ||
vidyate cet tribhuvanaṃ tat tattāṃ samprayāntu te /
tatra trilokatāṃ yātaṃ brahmety uktyarthadhīḥ kutaḥ |
evaṃrūpoktyarthākārā dhīḥ | evaṃrūpā uktiḥ evaṃrūpaḥ arthaś ceti yāvat |
bhavati | trailokyaśabdārthayor asambhavāt | na sambhavatīty arthaḥ |
anena prasaṅgena jagadbrahmaṇoḥ aikyam eva punaḥ punaḥ kathayati
brahmaiva jagad ity eva satyaṃ satyāvabodhinaḥ //
yathā hi hemakaṭake vicāryāpi na dṛśyate /
nirmalahāṭakam ṛte kaṭakatvaṃ nāma kvacit na dṛśyate
| yathā kaṭakaṃ hemaiva bhavati tathā jagat brahmaiva bhavatīti pūrvaślokadṛṣṭāntatayā yojyam uttaraślokadvayaṃ ca ||
jalād ṛte payovīcau nāhaṃ paśyāmi kiñcana /
spandatvaṃ pavanād anyan na kadācana kutracit /
spanda eva sadā vāyur jagat tasmān na vidyate //
iti | yataḥ jagataḥ brahmatve dṛṣṭāntatrayam asti
| ataś ca videhamuktasya sargatāgamanaṃ kathaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
punar api pūrvoktam artham eva sadṛṣṭāntaṃ kathayati
yathā śūnyatvam ākāśas tāpa eva marau jalam /
teja eva yathāloko brahmaiva trijagat tathā //
| jagadviṣayasyātyantābhāvasya muktatāsādhane kathaṃ sāmarthyam astīty atra yuktiṃ kathayeti bhāvaḥ ||
nanu yuktim eva kiṃ punaḥ punaḥ pṛcchasīty atrottarakathanapūrvaṃ praśnāntaraṃ karoti
brahma cetthaṃ svabhāvasthaṃ budhyate vada me tathā //
yataḥ tvayaivaitad uktam iti śeṣaḥ | yataḥ tvayā eva uktaṃ
rasāveśenonmattavat punar api dṛśyātyantābhāvasiddhiyuktiṃ brahmaṇaḥ itthaṃsvabhāvāvasthitiyuktiṃ ca pṛcchati
kayaitaj jñāyate yuktyā katham etat prasidhyati | /
etasmiṃs tu mune siddhe na sādhyam avaśiṣyate //
ayaṃ dṛśyātyantābhāvaḥ idam brahmaṇaḥ itthaṃsvabhāvāvasthānaṃ ca | nanu kimartham atra punaḥ punaḥ praśnān karoṣīty | atrāha
avaśiṣṭaṃ na bhavati | muktimātrasyaivākāṅkṣitatvāt tasya cānenaiva siddhatvāt ||
śuddhacinmātre dṛśyam idam ity evaṃrūpo jñānaviśeṣaḥ |
cātra kiṃrūpam idaṃ dṛśyam ity evaṃrūpo jñeyaḥ ||
nanv asmin samaye mayā kṛta eva leśato vicāraḥ | tat katham idaṃ dṛśyaṃ na śāntam ity | atrāha
na śakyate jhagity eva samucchedayituṃ kṣaṇāt /
ti | yathā kaścit parvatāgram ārūḍhaḥ tataś cāvataritum icchan
iti bahukālaṃ vicāraḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ ||
jagadbhrāntir yathā śāmyet tathedaṃ kathyate śṛṇu //
nanu tacchravaṇena mama kiṃ setsyatīty | atrāha
vadāmy ākhyāyikāṃ rāma yām imāṃ bodhasiddhaye /
tāṃ cec chṛṇoṣi tat sādho mukta evāsi buddhimān //
samanantarakṛtāṃ pratijñāṃ sampādayan prakaraṇārambhe pratijñātaṃ savistarakathanaṃ prastauti
yaḥ kilotpadyate rāma tena muktena bhūyate //
śabdaḥ ānantaryārthaḥ saṅkṣepakathanānantaratāṃ dyotayati | kimartham utpattiprakaraṇam eva prathamaṃ kathyate ity | atrāha
| ataḥ muktikathane pravṛttair asmābhiḥ utpattiprakaraṇakathanam eva kāryam | anyathā nirādhārāyāḥ mukteḥ kathanam ayuktaṃ syād iti bhāvaḥ ||
vistareṇa kathayiṣyamāṇe 'sminn utpattiprakaraṇe tvaṃ kiṃ kathayasīty | atrāha
iyam itthaṃ jagadbhrāntir bhāty ajātaiva khātmikā /
utpattiprakaraṇam eva kathayiṣyan sthūṇānikhanananyāyenotpattimūlakāraṇabhūtaśuddhacinmātraprakaṭanārtham ādau tadāvarakaprapañcalayaṃ tāvat kathayati
yad idaṃ dṛśyate kiñcij jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam | /
bhavaty asad adṛśyaṃ ca kvāpi yāti vinaśyati //
rudrādilayayukte | rudro 'tra ahaṅkāraḥ saṃhārādhikārī śrīmahādevo jñeyaḥ |
anirvācye kasmin cittattve ekatāṃ yāti | anyatayā sphuratīti yāvat | ata eva
adarśanaṃ gacchati | na hi bhāsamānasya sarvathā vināśo yuktaḥ | śuktikārajatasyāpi sarvathā vināśaprasaṅgāt | na hi śuktikārajataṃ sarvathā vinaśyati | kiṃ tu śuktibhāvena sphurati ||
nanu bhāsamānasyaitasya jagataḥ nāśe kiṃ śiṣyate | bhāsamānasya śuktikārajatasya nāśe hi śuktikā śiṣyate ity | atrāha
tataḥ stimitagambhīraṃ na tejo na tamas tatam /

śiṣṭaṃ bhavati | anyathā bhāsamānasya iyataḥ jagataḥ kutrāvasthānaṃ syān | na hi bhāsamānasya vināśo ghaṭasvarūpanāśavat yuktaḥ | śuktikārajatanāśavad anyarūpatayā sphuraṇamātrarūpatvāt | anyarūpatayā sphuraṇaṃ
svaviṣayāvagāhitrabhāvenāvagāhanakriyāviṣayatvābhāvena ca avagāhitum aśakyam | tādṛśaṃ ca tat tādṛśaṃ ceti | punaḥ kathambhūtaṃ |
jaḍapadārthavyatiriktam ity arthaḥ | atha vā cinmātrarūpatvena cetyasvarūpabāhyatejastamovyatiriktam iti jñeyam | punaḥ kathambhūtam |
ākhyāviṣayatvābhāvāc cākhyātum aśakyam ity arthaḥ | punaḥ kathambhūtaṃ |
bāhyāntaḥkaraṇāgocaratvena aprakaṭasvarūpam | kṛtaś ca pūrvam eṣāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ hetuhetumadbhāvena śṛṅkhalābandha iti na punar āyastam ||
avaśiṣṭatayā proktaṃ vastu punar api vistareṇa viśinaṣṭi
na śūnyaṃ nāpi cākāśaṃ na dṛśyaṃ na ca darśanam /
na ca bhūtapadārthaugho yad anantatayā sthitam //
bhavati | tattve hi jagadadhiṣṭhānatvam ayuktaṃ syāt | na
śūnyaṃ kasyāpi adhiṣṭhānaṃ dṛṣṭam | tatra bhāsamānasya
bhavati | proktanyāyena śūnyavyatiriktatvāt | ākāśasya ca śūnyaikamayatvāt |
na san nāsan na sadasan nābhāvo bhavanaṃ na ca //
kim apy anirvācyasvarūpaṃ bhavati | tathā yat
evaṃvidhaṃ bhavati | evaṃvidhaṃ kīdṛg ity apekṣāyām āha
| rogavaśena hi dṛṣṭyavayavabhūtāḥ raśmayaḥ mauktikabhāvena haṃsabhāvena cākāśe sphuranti |
idantayā viṣayīkṛtaṃ bhāvajātaṃ bhavati | sārabhāvena sthitatvāt |
yaḥ śṛṇoty āsvādayati jighran spṛśati paśyati //

sthitatvāt śravaṇādikriyākartṛtvābhimānagrastasamastadeśakālagatasamastapramātṛbhāvena vā sthitatvāt | na cendriyasāratvena sthitasyāsyānyendriyāpekṣā yuktā | indriyāṇām indriyāntaranairapekṣyeṇa tatsārasyāpi tadvat tadapekṣāyāḥ ayuktavāt | kalpyamānānām api teṣāṃ etatsāratvaṃ vinā nakiñcidrūpatvāpatteḥ | etatsāratve tu etasyaiva tadbhāvenāpi sthitatvāt | sarvapramātṛbhāvena sthitatve api nendriyāntarāpekṣā | tadindriyair evendriyamattvena indriyāntarāṇām anupayogitvāt ||
cinmātrasvarūpaḥ san draṣṭṛtām āpannaḥ sa eva | na tv anyaḥ kaścit |
dṛśyate | cidālokaṃ vinā draṣṭuḥ jagaddarśanāsambhavāt | kathambhūtaṃ
| ābhāsamātrarūpatvena svapnavat ākāśarūpaṃ cety arthaḥ | punaḥ kathambhūtam |
paramārthato jagadrūpatābhāvāt nakiñcidrūpam eva | punaḥ kathambhūtaṃ |
| paramārthato na sad ity arthaḥ | kathaṃ
puruṣaḥ svabhrūmadhye svadṛṣṭiraśmim eva tārakākārāṃ yathā paśyati | tathety arthaḥ | abhinayagamyaś cārthaḥ ||
yasyānyad asti na vibhoḥ kāraṇaṃ śaśaśṛṅgavat /
yasyedaṃ ca jagat kāryaṃ taraṅgaugha ivāmbhasaḥ //

stīty arthaḥ | nanu kathaṃ nāsya kāraṇam asti | satyam | tatkāraṇaṃ cidrūpam acidrūpaṃ vā | nāntyaḥ cidrūpaṃ prati acidrūpakāraṇatvāyogāt | ādye tu sa eva cidrūpaḥ cidrūpasya svasya kāraṇaṃ kathaṃ syāt | iti sarvasya jagataḥ tatkāryatvaṃ kathayati
sarvaṃ prakaṭayituṃ samarthasyety arthaḥ | punaḥ kathambhūtasya |

sārabhāvena sthitavataḥ | yuktaṃ ca dīpasya pātreṣv avasthānam | yady api suṣuptau cittaṃ līyata eva tathāpi bījatvenātrāsyāvasthānāt evam uktam | bahir api bhūrbhuvassvarākhyaṃ jagattrayaṃ cittenaiva bhāti ||
andhakārasadṛśāḥ | bhavanti | cakṣuṣā aprakāśitāḥ sūryādayo hi sphuṭam evāndhakārasadṛśā eva |
iyaṃ yasmiñ jagallakṣmīr alāta iva cakratā //
svarūpam eva | bhavati | na tv anyat | kathaṃ | sṛṣṭisaṃhāravilāsaḥ cetyamāno 'cetyamāno vā
etasyāsatkalpatvād alaṃ taccintayādye cidviṣayatayā cidantargatatvāt tadrūpa eveti na virodhaḥ | kathambhūtaḥ |
spandāspandasvarūpaḥ | tatra sṛṣṭivilāsaḥ spandamayaḥ | aspandamayaḥ saṃhāravilāsaḥ ||
sattā nāmnaiva bhinneva vyavahārān na vastutaḥ //
viśve taduttīrṇe ca svarūpe gatā | kasy
spandamayī sattā yayā vṛkṣādayaḥ kampante | 'spandamayī ākāśasvarūpā | nanu kathaṃ
ca jalasyaikatvaṃ yathā nipuṇair niścīyate tathātrāpīti na virodhaḥ ||
sarvadaiva prabuddho yaḥ supto yaḥ sarvadaiva ca /
na prasupto na buddhaś ca yaḥ sarvatraiva sarvadā //
ca | tatparāmarśarahitatvāt suptiṃ gataś ca bhavati |
svarūpaṃ yasya | tādṛśaḥ | ekasya yugapatspandamayatvaṃ vaicitryāvaham ||
āmoda iva puṣpeṣu na naśyati vināśiṣu /
tannāśe 'pi tadupādānatayā sūkṣmatvenāvasthānāt | na hi ghaṭe naṣṭe 'pi tadapekṣayā sūkṣmam upādānabhūtaṃ mṛtsvarūpaṃ naśyati | ka
naṣṭe 'pi tadāmodaḥ ākāśe bhrāmyan kiñcit kālaṃ
pratyakṣe vartamāno 'pi | na hi kasyacit svātmāpratyakṣaḥ nāham atrāsmīti | kim
| yathā paṭe vartamānaṃ śuklatvaṃ pratyakṣam api na hastena grāhyaṃ bhavati | tathety arthaḥ ||
yo bhoktā nityatṛpto 'pi kartā yaś cāpy akiñcana //
jñātā | na hi taṃ vinā ko 'py anyo mantā nāma syāt |
na bhavatīty arthaḥ | akartṛtvaṃ cāsya nakiñcanatvenaiva jñeyam | kartṛtvasya kiñcidrūpatvāt ||
na kiñcit saṃsthitenāpi yena vyāptam idaṃ jagat //
padam atrānantatāvācakaṃ | tena anantakaralocana ity arthaḥ | anantakaralocanatvaṃ cāsyānantadehe svātmabhūtatayā jñeyam |
| anyathā kiṃmayam etat syād iti bhāvaḥ |
leśenāpīty arthaḥ | nasaṃsthitatvaṃ vāsya grahītum aśakyatvāt ||
bhavanti | anyathā yena tena rūpeṇa bhāsamānānām āsāṃ kuta utthānaṃ syāt ||
padābhiprāyaḥ | paramātmājñānād eva hi tasmin saṃsāraḥ
dūre gacchanti | ītīnāṃ palāyanam ītirūpatāviparyayeṇa paramātmarūpatājñānam eva | tāsām api paramārthataḥ tadrūpatvāt ||
sākṣiṇi sphāra ābhāse dhruve dīpa iva kriyāḥ /
| tatsahitā ity arthaḥ | asati āntare kasmin cittattve vikalpānāṃ śarīraceṣṭānāṃ cotthānaṃ yuktaṃ na syād iti bhāvaḥ | kā
sannidhimātraṃ bhajati lokakriyā svayam eva pravartante | tathety arthaḥ ||

ghaṭapaṭasvarūpāḥ padārthaśatasamūhāḥ | bhavanti | yady api paramāṇvāder evopādānatvam anyair uktaṃ tathāpi cetanān prati tasyopādānatvābhāvāt kim api cetanācetanasvarūpam upādānaṃ kalpyam iti na vivādaḥ |
| yathā tāḥ ambudheḥ bhavanti | tathety arthaḥ ||
udayaṃ yāty | anyasvarūpatām iva bhajata ity arthaḥ | kaiḥ kṛtvā |
padārthaśatarūpāḥ bhramāḥ | taiḥ | padārthaśatair ity arthaḥ |
yas tvam ekāvabhāsātmā yo 'ham ete janāś ca ye /
| nanu paricchinna eva tarhy asau nety āha
ti | tvattādivikalparahitaśuddhacinmātrarūpeṇa paramārthataḥ sthitatvād ity arthaḥ ||
nyavat | bhāsamānety arthaḥ | avyatiriktasyānyatābhāsanaṃ vaicitryāvahaṃ | vyatirekābhāve 'pi jātivyaktyor iva aikyābhāvam āśaṅkya tanmayatāṃ kathayati
tadrūpatāyām apy atadrūpatayeva bhāsanaṃ sarvapratītisiddham eva ||
yataḥ kālasya kalanā yato dṛśyasya dṛśyatā /
mānasī kalanā yena yena bhāsāṃ vibhāsanam //
kalpanā bhavati | na hy āntaraṃ kalpayitāraṃ vinā kālasya kalpanā yukteti bhāvaḥ |
bhavati | na hi draṣṭāraṃ vinā dṛśyasya dṛśyatvam upapadyate |
bhavati | na hi sākṣiṇaṃ vinā mano 'pi sidhyati |
| bhavati | na hi jñātāraṃ vinā jñānāny utpadyante ||
kriyāṃ rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ sparśaṃ śabdaṃ ca cetanam /
ty asya sthāne karoṣīty etat sambandhanīyam | tenāyam arthaḥ | tvaṃ |
rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ sparśaṃ śabdaṃ yad vetsi tad
bhavati | etena kriyāphalasya tatkaraṇasya ca tanmayatā
bhavati | ayam atra nirṇayaḥ | sarvo vyavahāraḥ tāvat tripuṭyām eva sampadyate | tatra

ālambanabhūtaṃ karma | yadviṣayā kriyotpadyate | karaṇaṃ tv asādhāraṇakāraṇarūpam etebhyo na vyatiricyate | sāmagryā eva karaṇatvāt | tatrāhaṃ draṣṭety abhimānagrastād draṣṭuḥ grāhyaikarūpadṛśyaviṣayaṃ darśanam utpadyate | 'nyathā tayoḥ draṣṭṛdṛśyatāyogāt | draṣṭābhimānagrastatvān na jhagiti śuddhīkartuṃ śakyate | dṛśyaṃ tv atyantajaḍatayā tattulyayogakṣemam evātaḥ tau hitvā darśana evāvadhānaṃ vihitaṃ | nanu darśanam apy āśrayaviṣayadoṣeṇa dūṣitaṃ | natarāṃ śuddhīkartuṃ śakyate | satyaṃ | draṣṭari sthitāyā ahantāyāḥ dṛśyasthāyāḥ jaḍatāyāś ca nivāraṇam aśakyam eva | leśata ubhayasparśadūṣitasya darśanasya tu aṃśabhāvena sthitadoṣadvayanivāraṇaṃ suśakam eva | tatreyaṃ rītiḥ | darśanaṃ madrūpaṃ nāsti | sphuṭaṃ madvyatiriktatvāt | madvyatiriktatvaṃ cāsya
dṛśyarūpam api nāsti | grāhakatvāt | ataḥ tābhyāṃ vyatiriktaṃ kim api grahītum aśakyam avyapadeśyaṃ darśanaṃ nāmāstīti siddhā darśanasya paramātmarūpatā | tato
ca sā siddhataraiva | na hi darśanasambandhavilaye
atra darśanecchākālīnaṃ jñeyaṃ | tad dhi tadā āśrayaviṣayoparāgābhāvena śuddhatayaiva sphurati | paścāt tu sthūlatāṃ yāti ||
ajam ajaram ajāḍyaṃ śāśvataṃ brahma nityaṃ
] vettīti ⟨jātasya paryavasānarūpaṃ bhavati mahāpralaye śiṣyate iti⟩ yāvat
bhavati | sarvasya dṛśyajātasya paryavasānarūpaṃ bhavati | mahāpralaye śiṣyate iti yāvat | kathambhūtaṃ |
iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyām utpattiprakaraṇe navamaḥ sargaḥ ||
oṃ | atra moham āpanna iva śrīrāmaḥ pṛcchati
bhavatv etad anākāraṃ nāma nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ //
bahir anubhūyamānākārarahitaśūnyādivasturūpatānirāsas tu tasya na yujyata iti kathayati
na śūnyaṃ katham etat syān na prakāśaḥ kathaṃ bhavet /
kathaṃ vā na tamorūpaṃ kathaṃ vā naiva khātmakam //
| tad eva bhavatv ity arthaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra yojyam |
kathaṃ vā naiva cidrūpaṃ jīvo vā na kathaṃ bhavet /
kathaṃ na buddhitattvaṃ syāt kathaṃ vā na mano bhavet //
cidrūpatvasyāpi tatra paramārthatayā nivāraṇād etad uktam ||
kathaṃ vā na na kiñcit syāt kathaṃ vā sarvam ity api /
anayā ca vacobhaṅgyā mama moha ivoditaḥ //
kenāpi rūpeṇa sthitaṃ na bhavati | nakiñcittvasyāpi nirākaraṇāt |
bhinadmy enaṃ tv ayatnena naiśaṃ tama ivāṃśumān //
tad rāma na yathā śūnyaṃ tad idaṃ śṛṇu kathyate //
tathā viśvaṃ sthitaṃ tatra tena śūnyaṃ na tat padam //
na prakaṭīkṛtā | stambhe saṃsthitatvam asyā agre prakaṭībhāvāt | viśvasya sadrūpe
| niradhiṣṭhānasya bhramasyāyuktatvād iti bhāvaḥ | bhedenaiva bhātīty
tathā tāta jagad brahma tena śūnyaṃ na tat padam //
iti ca padadvayam ākṛṣyate | tenāyam arthaḥ |
somyāmbhasi yathā vīcir na cāsti na ca nāsti ca /
nanu tarhi putrikādisādṛśyena siddhā eva brahmaṇi jagatsthitir ity | atrāha
mohitena bhūyate | 'pi tu sarveṇaivety arthaḥ | kuto
ity arthaḥ | tacchāntiś cātra śuddhacinmātratayaiva jñeyā | mohaś ca deśakālādisparśarahite brahmaṇi kathaṃ jagad bhāti ity evaṃrūpo jñeyaḥ ||
yataḥ deśakālādisambhavena stambhe putrikāracanaṃ yuktaṃ | tacchāntyā tu ciddhātau tu na yuktam |
na sarveṇa prakāreṇa | na bhavatīty arthaḥ ||
na kadācid udetīdaṃ parasmān na ca śāmyati /
idaṃrūpaṃ kevalaṃ sad brahma svātmani saṃsthitam //
paramātmanaḥ | nanu yadi jagan nodeti na ca śāmyati tarhi kim idaṃ bhāsata ity | atrāha

svarūpaṃ | yasya | tat | tādṛśaṃ | śāntyudayasahitasya jagato brahmatvaṃ brahmāśrayabṛṃhāviṣayatvena jñeyaṃ | bṛṃhāviṣayo hi brahmasvarūpam eva bhavati | tathā ca brahmaṇaḥ śūnyatvaṃ na yuktam iti bhāvaḥ ||
kalpanaṃ | bhavati | tataḥ kim ity | atrāha
| na sta ity arthaḥ | sāpekṣayor ekanāśe dvayor api nāśād iti bhāvaḥ | kiñcidrūpatvābhāvaś ca nirālambaśuddhacinmātratayā jñeyaḥ ||
brahmaṇy ayaṃ prakāśo hi na sambhavati bhūtajaḥ /
ākṛtimattvena nāśasambhavān nātra sthitir yuktā | tadrūpatāyās tu kā
mahābhūtābhāvajaṃ tu tenātra na tamaḥ kvacit //
tejo'bhāvasyaiva tamastvaṃ vādibhiḥ pratipāditam iti bhāvaḥ | phalitam āha
lakṣaṇayā mahābhūtaprakāśābhāvāt jātaṃ | tadrūpam iti yāvat |
| mahābhūtapratiyogikābhāvāsambhavena tamo 'py atra na yuktaṃ | tadrūpasya tu kā katheti bhāvaḥ ||
nanu tejaso 'bhāve kathaṃ tat prakāśata ity | atrāha
yo 'ntar asti sa tenaiva na tv anyenānubhūyate //
prākaṭyakaraṇabhūtaṃ tejaḥ | svānubhūtyaivāsau bhāti na bāhyatejasety arthaḥ | kathambhūtad ity | atrāha
tatra praveśāsambhavāt | svayam evāsāv anubhavo 'nubhavitānubhavanam anubhūtiviṣayaś ceti | na tatra kasyāpy apekṣeti bhāvaḥ ||
muktaṃ tamaḥprakāśābhyām ity etad ajaraṃ padam /
bilvasya bilvasaṃjñasya yathā bhedo na kaścana /
tatheha brahmajagator na manāg api bhinnatā //
bhavati | yad eva brahma tad eva jagat | yad eva jagat tad eva brahmeti bhāvaḥ |
nanu tathāpi prakṛte kim āyātam ity | atrāha
salile 'ntar yathā vīcir mṛdo 'ntar ghaṭako yathā /
tathā yatra jagatsattā tat kathaṃ khātmakaṃ bhavet //
brahma tv ākāśaviśadaṃ tasyāntaḥsthaṃ tathaiva tat //
ākārasahitā bhavati | sākāratvena kathaṃ mṛjjalāder upamānayogyatvam ity | atrāha
nirākāraṃ | bhavati | sākārasya mṛdādeḥ nirākāraṃ brahma prati upamānatvaṃ na yuktam iti bhāvaḥ | phalitam āha |
punar apy upasaṃhāravyājena jagato nirākāratvaṃ sādhayati
tasmād yādṛk cidākāśam ākāśād api nirmalam /
| bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ | tena jagadrūpatayā bhāsamānatvena jagacchabdārthatābhāg apīty arthaḥ ||
marice 'ntar yathā taikṣṇyam ṛte bhoktur na lakṣyate /
na dṛśyate | bhoktari tu sati tenaiva lakṣyate ity arthaḥ |
| cetyacarvaṇād eva hi cinmātrasya cinmātratā jñāyate ||
tasya cātrābhāvāt | tasyābhāvaś cātra brahmāntaḥsthatvena brahmatayaiva jñeyaḥ | brahmābhinne jagaty api acittvam atidiśati |
cidrūpabrahmābhinnatvenācidrūpaiva bhavati | atra hetutayā viśeṣaṇam āha |
āyattā | acidbrahmasvarūpiṇīty arthaḥ | etena brahmajagatoḥ sarvathābhedo 'pi sādhitaḥ | na brahmaṇo
nanu jagataḥ sarvathābhinnatve rūpālokamanaskārāḥ kiṃrūpā ity | atrāha
yathāsthitam ato viśvaṃ suṣuptaṃ turyam eva vā //
iti | tanmayatvaṃ caiṣāṃ tadviṣayatvaṃ vināsatkalpatvāt | phalitam āha
anena prakāreṇaiva vartamānaṃ | na tu yayā kayāpi śaktyāntardhim āpāditaṃ |
iti | turyasvarūpacinmātraikamayam eva vā bhavatīty arthaḥ ||
jagataḥ turyarūpabrahmatvena yogino vyavahāre 'pi brahmamayatām āha
tena yogī suṣuptātmā vyavahāry api śāntadhīḥ /
prapañcaṃ prati suptāntaḥkaraṇaḥ | prapañcaṃ prati suptamanaso hi śāntadhītvaṃ yuktam eva | kathambhūtaṃ
nānābhāsebhyo niṣkrāntaṃ | taduttīrṇam ity arthaḥ | punaḥ kathambhūtaṃ |
punar api prakṛtaṃ brahmajagadabhedam eva kathayati
ākāriṇi yathā saumye sthitas toye dravakramaḥ /
anākṛtau tathā viśvaṃ sthitaṃ tatsadṛśaṃ pare //
anākṛtīty arthaḥ | saumye jale yathā sphuṭībhaviṣyamāṇatvena
'pi dravākhyo guṇaḥ tanmayaḥ | tathā bhāsamānatvena bhinnatvārho 'pi prapañcaḥ brahmamaya iti bhāvaḥ ||
pūrṇāt pūrṇaṃ prasarati saṃsthitaṃ pūrṇam eva tat /
ato viśvam anutpannaṃ yac cotpannaṃ tad eva tat //
bhavati | brahmatvena tasya sadā sthitatvāt | viśvānutpannatvam asahamānaṃ praty āha
brahmaiva | bhavati | utpannasyāpi brahmatvāviruddhatvād ity arthaḥ ||
etāvatyā prakriyayā siddham acidrūpatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kathayati

cicchabdapravṛttinimittatā | bhavati | na kāpīty arthaḥ | cetyaviṣayīkaraṇenaiva hi citaḥ cid iti nāma yuktam | cetyābhāve tu tan na yuktam | cetyābhāvaś ca savistaraṃ pūrvaṃ sādhitaḥ | cidarthatāniṣedhaś cātra taduttīrṇatayā jñeyaḥ na jaḍatayeti | atra samarthakaṃ dṛṣṭāntam āha
pratibimbenaiva jñāyate | tadabhāve tu sā na jñāyate | evaṃ parasya cittā cetyenaiva jñāyate | tadabhāve tu
paramāṇor api paraṃ tad aṇīyo 'py aṇīyasaḥ /
śuddhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ śāntaṃ tad ākāśodarād api //
dvyaṇukādyapekṣayā sūkṣmatarād api | sūkṣmataratvaṃ cāsya bāhyendriyāgrāhyatvena jñeyam |
śabdena vastuparigrahaḥ trividhaparicchedaśūnyatvād ity arthaḥ | nanu katham asya digādiparicchedaśūnyatvaṃ | tathātve 'py ativistṛtatvam iti cet |
tāvat cetyamānā na vā | na cet tarhi svayam evāsiddhā katham anyaṃ paricchedayet | cetyamānā cet tarhi citaiva sā paricchinnā kathaṃ tāṃ paricchedayet | evaṃ
ādibhiḥ paricchinnam eva paricchinnaṃ bhavati | tadabhāve tv ativistṛtam eveti sthitam
apy ādyantayoḥ sākṣitvād ādyantarahitam | punaḥ kathambhūtaṃ |
cidrūpam eva no yatra labhyate tatra jīvatā /
cetyaśayanāviṣṭaṃ cittatvaṃ cittaṃ | tadrūpiṇīty arthaḥ | punaḥ kathambhūtā |
cidrūpānudayād eva tatra nāsty eva jīvatā /
na buddhitā na cittattvaṃ nendriyatvaṃ na vāsanāḥ //

citsvarūpānudbhūter eva | na tv anyena hetunā | tadrūpānudayas tu pūrvaṃ kathitaḥ | sūkṣmarūpeṇa sthitā cetyabhāvanā vāsanā | nanu cidrūpānudayena katham atra jīvāditā nāsti | satyaṃ | ciducchūnatāyā eva jīvādibhāvena tadrūpatvānudaye yuktam eva jīvatādyabhāvatvam iti na virodhaḥ ||
evaṃ sthitaṃ layārambhapūrṇam apy ajaraṃ padam /
paramātmasvarūpaṃ durbodhaṃ jñātvā punar api śrīrāmaḥ pṛcchati
śiṣyate yat paraṃ brahma tad idaṃ varṇyate śṛṇu //
yad rūpaṃ yad anākhyeyaṃ tad rūpaṃ tasya vastunaḥ //
bhavati | atiśuddhatvena ākhyāyogyaṃ na bhavatīty arthaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | manasaiva manaḥ
nyāyena kiñcinmātraṃ samyakjñānena saṃsārakalanābhyo niṣkrāntaṃ śuddhaṃ manaḥ bhāvanābalena śuddhāśuddhavṛttikṣayeṇa hetunā śuddhāśuddhaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ

| tataḥ tan manaḥ śuddhatare kutrāpy anākhyeye layībhūtam anākhyeyaṃ bhavati | etadrūpatā ca suṣuptau sarvair anubhūyate | kiṃ tu mūḍhatāmiśrā | tac ca mano yadā tādṛk syāt tadāsya paramātmatābhāvaḥ bhavatīti | tatraiva yoginā sāvadhānena bhāvyam iti ||
nāsti dṛśyaṃ jagad draṣṭā dṛśyābhāvād vilīnavat /
bhātīti bhāsanaṃ yat syāt tad rūpaṃ tasya vastunaḥ //

draṣṭāpi layībhūta iva bhavati | tataś ca draṣṭā dṛśyaṃ ca nāstīti sphurati | tatsphuraṇaṃ ca draṣṭṛdṛśyaleparahitatvena nakiñcidrūpatvād anākhyeyaṃ bhavati | tad eva ca paramātmasvarūpam iti | tatra yoginā sāvadhānena bhāvyam iti ||
cinmātraṃ vimalaṃ śāntaṃ tat tat kāraṇakāraṇam //
chabdasya puṃliṅgatā | nanu kadāsau jīvasvabhāvo bhavatīty āha
syāt | cetyonmukhāyāḥ citer eva jīvatvāt | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | yac cinmātraṃ cetyonmukhaṃ sat jīvatāṃ yāti tad eva
cetyāsattvaṃ niścitya śuddhīkṛtaṃ sat anākhyeyaṃ bhavati | tad eva ca
iti | tatra yoginā sāvadhānena bhāvyam iti | citiś ca svaparāmarśakāritayā parāmarśakartṛtvena parāmarśaviṣayatvena ca dvividhāsti | tatra prathamāyāḥ cinmātram iti nāma dvitīyasyāḥ citir iti ||
cetaso rūpaṃ yat tat paramam ātmanaḥ //
tatrāśaktasya | tadā hi tasya mūḍhatvam eva bhavati | na paramātmatvam | kasmin
asparśaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | puruṣasya yasmin kasmiṃścic charīrāvayave kasyāpi dravyasya sparśe asati tadā
eva tad avayavavyāpi caitanyaṃ bhavet | tadā tadavayavamātrānusandhānaparasya tasya bāhyagrahaṇasamartham api manaḥ
eva tiṣṭhatīti | tadaiva sarvāḥ manovṛttīḥ vihāya yoginā sāvadhānena parīkṣyam iti ||
svapnatvenāpariṇatāyāḥ | jāgrati kriyamāṇā cintā svapnatvena pariṇamate | svapnatayā pariṇatatve tu
acchinnasantānatvena pravṛttāyāḥ | anyā kācic cintā tatra madhye nāyātīty arthaḥ |

avasthānaṃ | yasyāḥ | sā | tādṛśyāḥ | nirālambāyā ity arthaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | jāgrati kriyamāṇā chinnā jāḍyadoṣarahitā cintyamānasparśadūṣitā cintācchinnabodhamayācetyacinmayatām eva yāty | acetyacinmayam eva ca paramātmarūpam iti yoginā tatra sāvadhānena bhāvyam iti ||
yad vyomno hṛdayaṃ yad vā śilāyāḥ pavanasya ca /
mṛgyamānaṃ śūnyatāyām eva viśrāmyati | nanv etena jaḍatvam asyāyātam iti cen | na |
iti nāmadheyakathanena tannivāraṇāt | vicāre kriyamāṇe vyomādīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ yathāyathaṃ śūnyarūpam anyapraveśām
bhavati | tādṛg eva ca paramātmano rūpam iti yoginā tatra sāvadhānena bhāvyam ||
syāt sthitiḥ sā parā śāntā sattā
jīvayuktasya puruṣasya | na tu mṛtasya | kathambhūtasy

calanādikriyākāriṇaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | cetyaṃ prati manovyāpāram akurvan ata eva sarvathānusandhānaśūnyaḥ puruṣaḥ calanādikriyākārī yādṛśo bhavati tādṛg eva sṛṣṭyādivyāpārakāri param ātmatattvaṃ bhavatīti |
citprakāśasya yan madhyaṃ prakāśasya ghanasya ca /
darśanasya ca yan madhyaṃ tad rūpaṃ brahmaṇo viduḥ //

madhyāvasthā | bhavati | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | citprakāśasya bāhyaprakāśasya darśanasya ca tisro 'vasthā bhavanti | ādyāvasthā madhyāvasthāntyāvasthā | tatra bāhyaprakāśasyādityāder utthānasamaye yādyāvasthā sādityasparśadūṣitā | yā ca padārthaprakāśanasamaye 'ntyāvasthā sā padārthasparśadūṣitā | madhyāvasthā tu śuddhaprakāśasvarūpānākhyā ca bhavati | tādṛg eva ca paramātmasvarūpam iti | tatra yoginā sāvadhānena bhāvyam | citprakāśadarśanayor apy evaṃ yojyam | citprakāśasya darśanasya ca parimitatvāparimitatvamātrakṛto bhedo jñeyaḥ ||
vedanaṃ yad anādyantaṃ tad rūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ //
nairantaryeṇa pravṛttam | sāntarasyaiva hi madhye punaḥ punaḥ sāditvaṃ sāntatvaṃ ca bhavati | kasya |

| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | jñānadhāraṇā jñeyaikarūpadevatādhāraṇā ca nairantaryeṇa pravartamānā jñānaikamayatayā devataikamayatayā ca pariṇatā satī ekasvarūpaparamātmarūpā bhavatīti | tatra yoginā sāvadhānena bhāvyam | atha vā
bāhyatamasa iti yojyam | bāhyatejasaḥ bāhyatamasaś ca dhāraṇāyāḥ kaiścid uktatvāt ||
tanmayaṃ | punaḥ kathambhūtaṃ | sthitam iti śeṣaḥ |
iśabdopādānam | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | yataḥ sūkṣmatarād vastuna idaṃ jagat payasa iva vīcikadambakaṃ niryāti | tad eva paramātmano rūpam iti | tatra yoginā sāvadhānena bhāvyam iti ||
avyomna eva vyomatvaṃ tad rūpaṃ pāramātmikam //
vyomabhāvaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | vyavahāraṃ kurvann api puruṣaḥ tatratyasiddhyasiddhyanusandhānarahitaḥ paramātmarūpa eva bhavatīti | tatra yoginā sāvadhānena bhāvyam iti ||
yatrodety astam āyāti tat tat paramam
| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | vedyāditripuṭī cetyamānatvena kutracic cinmātrākhye vastuni udeti layībhavati ca | tad eva paramātmano
iti | yoginā tatra sāvadhānena bhāvyam iti ||
abuddhyādau mahādarśe tad rūpaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam //

buddhyādirahite | yuktaṃ cādarśasya buddhyādirahitatvam | ādarśasya jāḍyena buddhyādirahitatvam asya uttīrṇatveneti viśeṣaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | vedyāditripuṭī kṣaṇa eva sphuramāṇā kṣaṇa eva ca layabhāginī svasphūrtyāśrayasya kim api mālinyam anādadhatī pratibimbatayaiva bhāti | yataḥ pratibimbam api kṣaṇa eva sphurati kṣaṇa eva ca layībhavati svāśrayasya makurādeḥ mālinyaṃ na dadhāti | tava vedyāditripuṭīpratibimbāśrayaṃ tripuṭīvyatiriktaṃ kim api vastu svīkāryam | anyathā tripuṭīpratibimbāyogāt | tac ca tādṛśaṃ svīkriyamāṇam anākhyam eva bhavati | tad eva ca paramātmatattvam iti | tatra yoginā sāvadhānena bhāvyam iti ||
tṛṇādāv api tathaiva parvatādāv api | tṛṇādyudgamena naiva nirṇītam |
| na hi niścetanāt kasyāpy udgamo yuktaḥ | mṛtaśarīrād
| tathā ca yena rūpeṇa sarvatra cid asti tad anākhyam eva | tad eva ca paramātmatattvam iti | tatra yoginā sāvadhānena bhāvyam iti ||
yad rūpaṃ tac ced bodhamayaṃ bhavet /

bhavati | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | sthāvarāṇāṃ rūpaṃ avaśyaṃ kṣobharahitam eva kiṃ tu jāḍyadūṣitam | ataḥ jāḍyaṃ vihāya jñeyāsparśenaiva svaṃ jñānatattvaṃ kṣobharahitaṃ kāryaṃ | tataś ca paramātmaprāptir bhavatīti | tatra yoginā sāvadhānena bhāvyam iti | etāś ca dhāraṇāḥ pratyekaṃ paramātmaprāptyupāyabhūtā iti sphuṭīkṛtāḥ iti ||
śāntau śivaṃ paramam etad ihaikam āste /
svasvarūpe tathaiva tiṣṭhati | na tu naśyati | kasyāṃ satyāṃ |
iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyām utpattiprakaraṇe daśamaḥ sargaḥ ||
idaṃrūpam idaṃ dṛśyaṃ jagan nāmāsti bhāsuram /
mahāpralayasampattau bho brahman kva nu gacchati //
kuta āyāti kīdṛg vā vandhyāputraḥ kva gacchati /
kva yāti kuta āyāti vada vā vyomakānanam //
| nāśasamaya ity arthaḥ | etatsadṛśaḥ tava praśna iti bhāvaḥ ||
kīdṛśī dṛśyatā tasya kīdṛśī tasya nāstitā //
vartamānabhaviṣyanniṣedhena bhūtaniṣedho 'py ākṣiptaḥ | tataḥ kim ity | atrāha
jagadādy akhilaṃ dṛśyaṃ tathā nāsti kadācana //
na cotpannaṃ na ca dhvaṃsi yat kilādau na vidyate /
bhavati | nāśabhāg api na bhavati | tathā
| etad vaktum api na yuktam iti bhāvaḥ ||
sā yathā nāśajanmāḍhyā tathaivedaṃ na kiṃ bhavet //
niścaye | vandhyāputrādikalpanābhāve vandhyāputretyādikathaiva na yuktā syād iti bhāvaḥ | tataḥ kim ity | atrāha
anyatra striyi dṛṣṭasya putrasyāropeṇa yuktaiva vandhyāputrakalpanātra tu dṛśyasya kva
sattaiva nāstīti na tatkalpanā yuktety uttaraṃ śrīvasiṣṭho bhaṅgyāntareṇāha
kam apy artham anuddiśya pravṛttā | vyartheti yāvat | bhavati |
kaṭakatvaṃ tu nāsty eva jagattvaṃ tu tathā pare //
yathā sauvarṇakaṭake sphuṭaṃ dṛśyamānam api kaṭakatvaṃ nāsti
ākāśe ca yathā nāsti śūnyatvaṃ vyatirekavat /
jagattvaṃ brahmaṇi tathā nāsty evāpy upalabdhimat //
vyatirekayuktam | ākāśaśūnyatvayoḥ vyatirekānupalabdher ity arthaḥ | dārṣṭāntikam āha
kajjalān na yathā kārṣṇyaṃ śvaityaṃ ca na yathā himāt /
pṛthag evaṃ bhaved buddhaṃ jagan nāsti pare pade //
yathā śaityaṃ ca śaśino na himād vyatiricyate /
brahmaṇo na tathā sargo vidyate vyatirekavān //
nāsty evaivaṃ jagan nāsti dṛṣṭam apy amalātmani //

ty arthaḥ | nanu pūrvaṃ kaṭakādayaḥ dṛṣṭāntatvenopāttā iha tu marujalādīti vaiṣamyam āpatitam iti cen | na | pūrvadṛṣṭāntaiḥ brahmaikarūpatvaṃ jagata uktam | ihāsatyatvam | phalatas tu sarveṣāṃ dṛṣṭāntānāṃ brahmaikatāyām eva tātparyam iti na kiñcid viruddham ||

bhūtākāśe | sphurati | tathety arthaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | yathā netrān nirgatāḥ raśmayaḥ ākāśe sphurantaḥ muktāvalīrūpeṇa dṛśyante | tathā cita utthitāḥ cidālokākhyāḥ raśmayaḥ jagadākhye cidambare sphurantaḥ nānāpadārtharūpeṇa dṛśyante iti ||
tad eva tena rūpaṃ svaṃ jagad ity avabudhyate //
sphurati | aham iti svaparāmarśaviṣayo bhavatīti yāvat | parāmarśābhāve hi tasya cittvam eva na syāt |
ādāv eva hi yan nāsti kāraṇāsambhavāt svayam /
vartamāne 'pi tan nāsti nāśaḥ syāt tatra kīdṛśaḥ //
nanu paramātmalakṣaṇasya kāraṇasya sadbhāvāt kāraṇāsambhavaḥ katham udety | atrāha
kāraṇaṃ bhavituṃ śaktaṃ chāyāyā ātapo yathā //
pṛthvyādeḥ jaḍavastunaḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavituṃ kva śaktaṃ
| na śaktam ity arthaḥ | atra dṛṣṭāntam āha
nanu kāraṇābhāve 'pi jagad astu ity | atrāha
yat tatkāraṇam evāsti tad evettham avasthitam //
leśenāpīty arthaḥ | punaḥ kim etad dṛśyata ity | atrāha
bhavati | na tv anyat kiñcid iti bhāvaḥ ||
ajātam eva yad bhāti saṃvido bhānam eva tat /
yaj jagad dṛśyate svapne saṃvitkacanam eva tat //
tathātvena sphuraṇam eva | bhavati | atrānurūpaṃ dṛṣṭāntam āha
ity anena jagataḥ parāmarśaḥ | svapnasya saṃvitkacanarūpatvaṃ sarvapratītisiddham eveti dṛṣṭāntatvena gṛhītam ||
yad idaṃ dṛśyate kiñcit tat sad evātmani sthitam /
nāstam eti na codeti jagat kiñcit kadācana //
iti | ata ity adhyāhāryaṃ | cinmātrākhyena rūpeṇa sadaiva sthitatvād iti bhāvaḥ ||
yathā dravatvaṃ salilaṃ spandatvaṃ pavano yathā /
deḥ pṛthakkṛtya darśayituṃ samartha iti bhāvaḥ |
yathā puram ivāste 'ntar vid eva svapnasaṃvidi /
| na tv anyaj jagan nāmāstīti bhāvaḥ ||
evaṃ cet tat kathaṃ brahman sughanapratyayaṃ vada /
svapnākārā anubhūtiḥ | svapnam iti yāvat | tad
dṛśyātyantāsambhavaṃ vinā muktim amanyamānaḥ tam eva vistareṇa pṛcchati
sati dṛśye kila draṣṭā sati draṣṭari dṛśyatā /
ekasattve dvayor bandho muktir ekakṣaye dvayoḥ //
bhavati | draṣṭṛsattāyāṃ ca dṛśyasattā bhavati | yataḥ
syāt | tasmāt muktyartham ekakṣaya eva sādhyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ ||
nanu tatrāpi kiṃ punaḥ punaḥ dṛśyātyantābhāvam eva pṛcchasīty | atrāha
ca dṛśyātyantābhāvaṃ vinā duṣkaratvāc ca punaḥ punaḥ dṛśyātyantābhāvapraśna iti bhāvaḥ ||
nanu dṛśyātyantābhāve tava kiṃ prayojanaṃ | dṛśyadhvaṃsenāpi kāryasiddher ity | atrāha
dṛśyaṃ cet sambhavaty ādau paścāt kṣayam upāgatam /
dṛśyasmaraṇam evānarthaḥ | saḥ rūpaṃ yasya | saḥ tādṛśaḥ
nāśaṃ na yāti | pūrvaṃ satyatayā jñātasya tato naṣṭasyārthasya smaraṇaṃ hi durnivāram eva | yathā mātrāder iti bhāvaḥ |
bhavati | tasmāt traikālika evābhāvo 'trāṅgīkaraṇīya iti bhāvaḥ ||
nanu naṣṭasya dṛśyasya kā smṛtir bhavatīty | atrāha
pratibimbo lagaty eva sargasmṛtimayo hy ayam //
| yathā yatra kvacana saṃsthitasyādarśasya padārthasānnidhye pratibimbo lagati tathā yatra kvacana sthitāyāḥ cidgateḥ sūkṣmatvena sthitadṛśyasānnidhyāt pratibimbo lagatīty arthaḥ ||
ādāv eva hi notpannaṃ dṛśyaṃ nāsty eva cet svayam /

| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | dṛśyātyantābhāve sati puruṣasyedaṃ dṛśyam iti bhramaḥ śāmyati | tacchāntau cāhaṃ draṣṭeti bhramo 'pi śāmyaty eva | tataś ca śuddhacinmātrasvarūpa evāsau śiṣyate | tad eva ca muktir iti ||
asad eva yathā bhāti jagat sarvātmakaṃ
śṛṇv ahaṃ kathayā rāma dīrghayā kathayāmi te //
nanu kimarthaṃ dīrghayā kathayā kathayasīty | atrāha
na viśrāmyati te tāvad dhṛdi pāṃsur yathā hrade //
nanu dṛśyātyantābhāvajñānena kiṃ mama setsyatīty | atrāha
kūṭakārṣāpaṇavyavahāravat kariṣyasi | na tu vairāgyāvasthāvat tadvimukho bhaviṣyasi | mūḍhatvāvasthāvad vā tadāsaktaḥ |
sattvarūpaṃ manaḥ yasya | saḥ | tādṛśaḥ | antaḥ cinmātradhyāna ekaniṣṭhaḥ |
vyavahārabhāg api bhaviṣyasīty arthaḥ | kiṃ kṛtvā |
nanu tato 'pi kim ity apekṣāyāṃ phalāntaram api kathayati
dṛśas tvāṃ vedhayiṣyanti na mahādrim iveṣavaḥ //
tyāgaḥ | bhāvādīnām api dṛśyatayātyantābhāvasya sampannatvān na tatkṛtā tāḍanā tava bhaviṣyati | na hi vandhyāputreṇa kaścit tāḍita iti bhāvaḥ | tāḥ kā
| yathā iṣavaḥ mahāntaṃ parvataṃ na vidhyanti | tathety arthaḥ ||
sa eṣo 'sty eka evātmā na dvitīyāsti kalpanā /
jagad atra yathotpannaṃ tat te vakṣyāmi rāghava //
| tathā ca dṛśyātyantābhāvaḥ sphuṭa eveti bhāvaḥ | tarhi bhāsamānaṃ jagat katham astīty | atrāha
jagat yathā utpannaṃ tat te vakṣyāmi
yo hīdam aṅga sakale sakalaṃ mahātmā /
dṛśyarūpāṇi vilāsitāni | mṛda iva ghaṭā niryāntīti śeṣaḥ |
indriyeṇālokitasya rūpasya manomananadvāreṇa sākṣibhūte cinmātre sphuraṇam | teṣāṃ
tiṣṭhanti | tata eva ca niryāntīty arthaḥ | iti śivam ||
iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyām utpattiprakaraṇe ekādaśaḥ sargaḥ ||
yathedam utthitaṃ viśvaṃ tac chṛṇūttamayā dhiyā //
suṣuptaṃ svapnavad bhāti bhāti brahmaiva sargavat /
sarvam ekaṃ ca tac chāntaṃ tatra tāvat kramaṃ śṛṇu //
| nanu tarhi jagadupādānabhūtaṃ brahma jagadvad eva jaḍaṃ syāt | kāryavaiguṇyayuktasya kāraṇasyādarśanāt ity | atrāha
bhavati | sarvathāścaryam eva tad iti bhāvaḥ | nanu katham utpadyata ity | atrāha
tad ātmani svayaṃ kiñcic cetyatām iva gacchati /
svenaiva | na tu parapreraṇayā | parasya tatrābhāvāt | kasmin |
sphuraṇam | aham iti parāmarśa iti yāvat |
sattāmātrasvarūpaṃ | sphurattārūpe kacana eva sattāvyavahārāt | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | śuddha
mānatvaṃ ca cidviṣayatvaṃ | tac ca citsambandhaḥ | citāthācidrūpasya
na yujyate viruddhatvāt | na hi tejastamasoḥ sambandhaḥ kvāpi dṛṣṭaḥ | citaś ca śāntatvam uktanyāyena cetyāsambhavenaiva siddham iti ||
cidbhāvāt | cetyarūpajagattayābhāne cittvam eva tasya na syād iti bhāvaḥ |
vinaśyaty asad evānte svapne svamaraṇaṃ yathā //
pūrvoktādhāratvādheyatvādirogarahitaṃ bhavati | na tv abhāvayuktam | tadabhāvaś ca tadākrāntabuddhīn satyaṃ tadrūpam apaśyataḥ praty evoktaḥ | kathambhūtam
eva | na tu mudgarādiprahāraiḥ nāśitaṃ sat |
samyagjñānenālocitaṃ hi jagat ambarodaram eva bhavati ||
sa hy ātivāhikavapur na tu bhūtarūpī
pṛthvyādi tena na sad asti yadā na jātam //
sphurati | tathā ca pūrvoktā sarvā prakriyā sargārambhaṃ vinā atuṣṭamanasaḥ praty eveti bhāvaḥ | kathambhūtaḥ |
śuddhatvena tatsamānaḥ | na tu tadrūpaḥ jaḍatvāpatteḥ |
| nanu prajeśasyāpṛthvyādirūpatayā kathaṃ na pṛthvyādi sat astīty | atrāha

sti | śuddhamanorūpasya prajeśasya tadrūpatāgrahaṇena pṛthvyāder jātatvaṃ syān | na tu pūrvanyāyena prajeśasya tadrūpatāgrahaṇaṃ sambhavaty | ataḥ pṛthvyāder api jātatvaṃ na sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | iti śivam ||
iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyām utpattiprakaraṇe trayodaśaḥ sargaḥ ||
oṃ | evaṃ jagato 'tyantābhāvaṃ paramātmaikamayatāṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ uktvā tāvanmātram eva sādhanīyaṃ jñātvā punar api tad eva kathayati
itthaṃ jagad ahantādi dṛśyaṃ jātaṃ na kiñcana /
uttīrṇaṃ cinmātram eva | bhavati | na tu jagat |
yat bhāsamānatvena nirākartuṃ na śakyata ity arthaḥ ||
nanu tarhi pūrvaṃ sādhitā jīvatā katham astīty | atrāha
| cetanaṃ cātra tadyogyatāmātram eva | na hi tatra salilasya saspandatā kenāpy aṃśena yuktā | evaṃ brahmaṇy api jīvatāyogyatvamātram eva | na tu
saspandatāyuktatvāt yogyatājñānaṃ | brahmaṇi jīvarūpatayā bhāsaneneti viśeṣaḥ ||
| tattyāge tu vedanam asya na syād iti bhāvaḥ | k
svapne saṅkalpe ca svaviṣayīkṛte svasvarūpaparvatādau sthitāṃ |
sūkṣma eva | bhavati | atra hetutvena viśeṣaṇam āha
ti | yataḥ cinmātrākhyanirmalākāśasvarūpaḥ | cinmātramayasya śarīrasyātivāhikatvaṃ svapne dṛṣṭam iti nāyastam ||
| karmaṇāṃ ca janmahetutvaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu prasiddham eva | kāryāṇām abhāvaś cāsya cinmātrataḥ sadya utthitatvena jñeyaḥ | kiṃrūpo 'sau |
itarasvapnaśailavat kṣaṇikatvadoṣarahitaḥ yaḥ svapnaśailaḥ | tadvad ābhā yasya | sa
yasya | saḥ | etena viśeṣaṇadvayenātivāhikatāyām apy asya sthiratoktā | citrakṛti sthitaṃ cittaṃ
ti viśeṣaṇasyaiveyaṃ vyākhyā | etena viśeṣaṇadvayena brahmaikamayatāsyoktā ||
mucyante sarva evātaḥ prāktanaṃ karma teṣu kim //
bhavati | na kiñcid apīty arthaḥ | tathā ca | sarve 'pi te 'pakāraṇā eveti bhāvaḥ ||
moktavya eva kuḍyātmā dṛśyo 'dṛśyaś ca saṃsthitaḥ /
na ca dṛśyaṃ na ca draṣṭā na sraṣṭā sarvam eva ca //
praticchandaḥ padārthānāṃ sarveṣām eṣa eva saḥ /
asmād udeti jīvālī dīpālī dīpakād iva //
samaṣṭirūpaḥ ābhāsaḥ | bhavati | sarveṣām ābhāsānām etatsvarūpatvāt | kathambhūto 'sau |
hi rodhakatvena madhye gantuṃ na śakyate | 'yaṃ tu apūrvam eva kuḍyaḥ | moktavyatvam asya sarveṣāṃ dṛśyasañcārāṇāṃ praveśanirgamamahattvāt | kuḍyatvaṃ tu sarvādhāratvena | punaḥ kathambhūtaḥ |
na dṛśyaṃ na ca draṣṭā na sraṣṭā
| nanu katham ayaṃ praticchandaḥ astīty | atrāha
prādurbhavati | nanu mṛdo ghaṭālī rajjusamūhāt vā
tathā udeti | na tayoḥ tatpraticchandatvaṃ dṛśyate ity | atrāha
ti | vivartapariṇāmābhyām anya eva praticchandyapraticchandakarūpaḥ prakāraḥ atrāstīti bhāvaḥ ||
kṣmādimān iva niṣkuḍyaḥ svapnāt svapnāntaraṃ yathā //
asmād eva praticchandāj jīvāḥ samprasaranty amī /
sañcāraṃ yānti | tarhi tata utpannatvena tato bhinnā eva syur ity | atrāha
bhavanti | na tu tato bhinnāḥ | kutaḥ |
| sahakārikāraṇābhāve kāryaṃ kāraṇarūpam eveti hi prasiddhiḥ ||
ekam etad ato nānyaḥ parasmāt sargavibhramaḥ //
sargaḥ | bhavati | pādapūraṇārtho bhāvapratyayaḥ | upasaṃhāraṃ karoti
jīvākāśa iti śrutvā kiñcit saṃśayam āpannaḥ śrīrāmaḥ pṛcchati
kiṃ syāt parimito jīvarāśir āho anantakaḥ /
mṛtpiṇḍavat eka eva kaścij jīvamayaḥ piṇḍa iti bhedaḥ ||
dhārāḥ payomuca iva śīkarā iva vāridheḥ /
iti | jīvarāśeḥ jīvapiṇḍasya vānaṅgīkāre eteṣāṃ niryāṇaṃ na sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
jñātam etan mayā prāyas tad eva prakaṭīkuru //
| etāvad uktvā tvayā kiṃ na śrutam ity | atrāha
eka eva na jīvo 'sti rāśīnāṃ sambhavaḥ kutaḥ /
| tathā jīva eva nāsti | kā kathā tadrāśyāder iti bhāvaḥ ||
na jīvo 'sti na jīvānāṃ rāśayaḥ santi rāghava /
na ca ekaḥ kaścana parvataprakhyaḥ jīvapiṇḍo 'sti
nanu jīvādīnāṃ pratyakṣeṇa sphuraṇāt katham ayaṃ niścayaḥ
śuddhaṃ cinmātram amalaṃ brahmāstīha hi sarvagam /
tad yathā sarvaśaktitvād vindate yāṃ svayaṃ kalām //
nanu mūrtām amūrtāṃ vā tām evāśu prapaśyati ||
sampannām eva paśyati | tathā ca | jīvaḥ paramārthataḥ svayaṃ siddho nāsti | kasya rāśitā piṇḍatā vā bhaved iti bhāvaḥ ||
nanu yadi brahma jīvādi paśyati tadā tadbhinnam evaitat syāt | svabhinnasyaiva dṛṣṭigocaratvād ity | atrāha
sphurantīṃ | tathā ca | dṛṣṭigocaratve 'pi na jīvāder bhinnatvaṃ yuktam iti bhāvaḥ ||
nanu brahmasattā kathaṃ jīvādibhāvena sphuratīty | atrāha
sābuddhaivaṃ bhavaty eva bhaved brahmaiva bodhataḥ /
yāti nāśaṃ na tu sa budhyate //

| sattātadvatoḥ bhedābhāvāt | nanu jīvādeḥ brahmasattābhāvena brahmamayatve 'pi brahmasattāviṣayas tu yaḥ abodha āsīt saḥ abodhatvena jñātaḥ san ghaṭādivat tathaiva tiṣṭhati | tathā ca na brahmaikamayatā
bodhaviṣayo na sampadyate viruddhatvāt tadudbodhakāle eva naṣṭatvāt | na hi tamaḥ tejoviṣayo bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ||
na cāsya jñāyate tattvam abodhasyaivam eva hi //
vibhāgarahitaḥ | na hi jīvasvarūpe kaścid vibhāgo 'sti niravayavatvāt |
ādyantarahitatvaṃ cāsyādyantaparicchedakatvenaiva siddham | na hi paricchedyaḥ paricchedakasya paricchedaṃ kartuṃ
sarvānantatayā tv asya na kācid bhedakalpanā /
vidyate yā hi kalanā sā tad evānubhūtitaḥ //
sti | sarvarūpasyānantasya ca bhedāyogāt | na hi ghaṭādyapekṣayānantasya ghaṭaśarāvādisarvarūpasya mṛdādeḥ ghaṭabhedo yuktaḥ | nanu sarvatvam anantatvaṃ ca asarvāt
ca bhedakam eva | tathā ca tābhyām eva tasya bhedaḥ sampadyata ity | atrāha

anubhūtisvarūpataḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ | yā kācit kalanāsti sānubhūtā na vā | na cet sā svayam asiddhā brahmaṇi bhedaṃ kathaṃ kuryāt | anubhūtā cet tarhi anubhavarūpaivānubhavasya ca cidrūpatvena brahmatvaṃ siddham eveti | brahmaiva sā bhaved iti ||
bhavati | satyam eva bhavatīty arthaḥ | sarveṣāṃ jīvānāṃ tatraikajīvecchānuvartitvam āśaṅkate |
ekasmin jīve uditayecchayā sarveṣāṃ jīvānāṃ yogo yuktaḥ ||
yasya | tat | tādṛśam | sarvaśaktimayātmakatvaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ sarvaśaktīnāṃ tata evotthānāt | punaḥ kathambhūtaṃ |
nanu brahma yathecchaṃ sthitaṃ bhavatu | tataḥ kim ity | atrāha
yad evecchati tat tasya bhavaty āśu mahātmanaḥ /
pūrvaṃ tu naśyatīcchā cid ato dvitvam udeti tat //
icchā | nīlam utpalam itivat cidviśeṣitecchā jñeyā | cidviśeṣitatvaṃ cātra cidviṣayatvaṃ jñeyam | yata ity adhyāhāryam | tenāyam arthaḥ | yataḥ
icchā | cidrūpa eva bhavāmīty evaṃrūpā ekatecchā |
nāśaṃ yātīva | paramārthataḥ tu na naśyati tasyāḥ sarvatrānugamāt | iti
śabdopādānam | cidviṣayecchānāśaś ca cetyaviṣayecchodbhūter eva jñeyaḥ |
prādurbhavati | ekatecchānāśahetubhūtatayā dvitvecchayā eva dvitvam udetīti bhāvaḥ ||
anenetthaṃ hi bhavatīty evaṃ tena kriyākramaḥ //
śaktyādyayā tayā brāhmyā niyamo yaḥ prakalpitaḥ /
jīvecchārūpeṇa pariṇamate | tathā ca pradhānecchānuvartitvam eva | na sā niyamakāritvam uktam | iha tu tacchakter iti cen | na | śaktitadvator abhedāt ||
phalayuktā bhavati | tasyā ity adhyāhāryam | tasyāḥ śakteḥ
bhavati | svarūpam eva na labhate | kā kathā tatphalasyeti bhāvaḥ ||
tat phalaṃ śaktyaśaktatvān nehitānāṃ kvacid bhavet //
| yataḥ rohitānāṃ nānāvidhānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ phalaṃ vidyate 'taḥ anumīyate ko 'pi niyamo 'sti yena kriyāṇāṃ phalotpādanaṃ prati sāmarthyam astīti bhāvaḥ ||
svayam eva tadrūpo bhavati | na tu tato jīvāḥ niryāntīti bhāvaḥ |
nanu brahma kena jīvatāṃ yātīty | atrāha
sukhaduḥkhalepasvarūpasaṃsārabhāk bhavati | nanu kadācit saṃsṛtir asya nivartate na vety | atrāha
nanu saṃsṛtyupaśamena jīvasya kiṃ sampadyata ity | atrāha
jñātavyāḥ | brahmakṛtakriyākramasyaiva jīvānāṃ brahmatvāpādane samarthatvāt | atra dṛṣṭāntam āha
atrānante parākāśe ittham eṣa gaṇo 'py asan /
svayam eva camatkāro yaḥ samāgamyate citā /
| ahaṅkāro 'pi ciccamatkāra eva | kā kathā jīvasyeti ahambhāvagrahaṇābhiprāyaḥ | kathambhūtaṃ |
cito yaḥ syāc cidālokas tanmayatvād anantakaḥ /
sa eṣa bhuvanābhoga iti tasyāḥ prabimbati //
cidvad aparimeyaḥ | aparimeyatvaṃ ca citaḥ parimātur abhāvena svayaṃ svasmin parimātṛtāsambhavāc ca jñeyam |
vijñāyate | śabdasyārthabodhaṃ prati kāraṇatvaṃ suprasiddham eveti nāyastam | kathambhūt
bhinnīkartum ayogyāpi | nanu svarūpād abhinnatve kathaṃ pariṇāmādiśabdavācyatvaṃ asyā iti cet | satyam | yathā toyaṃ svarūpād abhinnam api taraṅgatām
toyapariṇāmaśabdena tadvikāraśabdena ca kathyate tatheyam apīti na virodhaḥ ||
acetyasya prakāśasya jagad ity eva tat sthitam //
ākāśād api sūkṣmaiṣā yā śaktir vitatā citaḥ /
iyaṃ svātmani tasyaiva jagannāma kṛtaṃ tatam //
citaś cittvam ahaṅkāraḥ saiva rāghava kalpanā /
bhavati | ahaṅkāratayā cittvasyaiva pariṇāmād ity arthaḥ | he

bhavataḥ | na sta iti bhāvaḥ | nanu dvitvaṃ mā bhavatu | ekatvaṃ kathaṃ nāstīti cen | maivaṃ | svapratipakṣaṃ dvitvaṃ vinaikatvasyāpy asiddheḥ | na hi chāyāṃ vinā prakāśaḥ prakāśo bhavati anirvācyatvāt ||
evaṃ cidekamayatvaṃ sarvasya prasādhya bhedatyāgaṃ śiṣyaṃ prati anuṣṭheyatvena vidadhāti
| yena jīvatā dūre gacchatīti bhāvaḥ | punaḥ kiṃrūpaḥ tiṣṭhāmīty | atrāha
evaṃ śiṣyaṃ prati abhedaṃ vidheyatvenoktvā tatkṛpayā punar apy abhedam eva kathayati
citā yathādau kalitā svasattā sā tathoditā /
abhinnā dṛśyate vyomnaḥ sattāsatte 'tha vedmy aham //
Zu komponieren aufgrund von Bhāskaras Deutung von
| yataḥ sarvaṃ kharūpaṃ ciccamatkāramātrarūpaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ ||
yo yadvilāsas tasmāt sa na kadācana
| na hi kaścit taraṅgaṃ toyāt bhinnaṃ
citer nityam acetyāyāś cin nāsty avitatākṛteḥ /
rūpaṃ yasyāḥ | sā | tasyāḥ | nanu etad asiddhaṃ | sphurāmītirūpeṇa yuktatvād ity | atrāha
| na tu citeḥ | mukhyataḥ cititvaṃ hi sphurāmīty asya grāhikāyāḥ citer eva | sphurāmīti grāhyarūpāyās tu gauṇaṃ
bhavad api na jagattvaṃ vyabhicarati | kathambhūtasya
| yat kiñcic cetyatām āyāti tat sarvaṃ jagad evety arthaḥ ||
mano buddhir ahaṅkāro bhūtāni girayo diśaḥ /
cidrūpatvāt | sarve śabdāḥ cidvācakā eveti bhāvaḥ ||
ajagattvād acic cit syād bhāvābhedāj jagat kutaḥ //
cidbhāvaṃ | yena sā cid iti nāmayogyā bhavati sa ko 'pi dharmaḥ | tam iti yāvat |
| cetyarūpajagadabhāve 'nirvācyāyāḥ citaḥ sphuṭaṃ cittvāyogyatvāt | avāntaraṃ phalitam āha
iti | ata ity adhyāhāryam | ato hetoḥ |
cinnāmayogyā na syāt | yadi jagan na syād anirvācyāyāḥ citer api cittvaṃ na syād iti bhāvaḥ | paramaṃ phalitam āha
kathaṃ | syāt | cittvajagator abhede sati cittvasya cidekamayatayā cita eva sarvathā sthitatvāt jagan nāstīti bhāvaḥ ||
saiv⟨e⟩[ai]ṣā jagad iti jagadrūpeṇa ⟨saiveṣā jagad iti jagadrūpeṇa⟩
kevalaṃ jīvapañcatanmātrasvarūpaṃ | na tu sthūlabhūtamayaṃ | svapnanyāyena sthūlatāyā asatyatvāt ||
| paricchinnasyaiva hi vastunaḥ nāma tadvācyatvaṃ ca kartuṃ śakyaṃ |
| taiḥ | tadyuktatvād iti yāvat | cito bhinnaṃ | kā hānir ity | atrāh

| cidbhinnasya cetyamānatāyogāt | tadayoge ca sato 'pi | tasyāsaṅkalpatvāt | cidrūpatvena kalanābhāvena vyarthasya cittvasyāpy abhāvaḥ | cittvābhāve ca jagato 'bhāvaḥ | tadabhāve ca śuddhasya cinmātrasyaiva sāmrājyam iti bhāvaḥ ||
